data.title: Češi zbytečně přeplácí za elektřinu, špatně nastavené sazby je stojí přes miliardu
data.description: České domácnosti mohou zbytečně platit za elektřinu dohromady více než 1,3 miliardy korun ročně. Důvodem je nevhodně zvolená distribuční sazba. Velká část domácností má nastavenou sazbu nevýhodně, kvůli čemuž zbytečně přeplácí stovky korun ročně. Většina z nich přitom o možnosti zvolení jiné sazby ani neví. Vyplývá to z analýzy společnosti bezDodavatele.
data.translatedTitle: Czechs are unnecessarily overpaying for electricity, incorrectly set rates are costing them over a billion
data.translatedDescription: Czech households can unnecessarily pay a total of more than 1.3 billion crowns a year for electricity. The reason is an inappropriately chosen distribution rate. A large number of households have set the rate disadvantageously, which is why they needlessly overpay hundreds of crowns per year. Most of them do not even know about the possibility of choosing a different rate. This follows from the analysis of the company bezDodavatel.

data.title: Trump: USA a Izrael odloží tvrdý útok na Írán, chtějí otevřít Hormuzský průliv
data.description: Americký prezident Donald Trump uvedl, že Spojené státy a Izrael na žádost Teheránu a dalších zemí regionu odloží plánovaný tvrdý útok na Írán, pokud bude brzy dosaženo dohody umožňující plné otevření Hormuzského průlivu. „USA jsou plně připraveny a připraveny zaútočit na Islámskou republiku Írán s úrovní vojenského teroru, síly a moci, která nebyla k vidění od druhé světové války,“ uvedl Trump.
data.translatedTitle: Trump: The US and Israel will postpone a tough attack on Iran, they want to open the Strait of Hormuz
data.translatedDescription: US President Donald Trump said the United States and Israel would delay a planned heavy-handed attack on Iran at the request of Tehran and other countries in the region if an agreement to fully open the Strait of Hormuz is reached soon. "The United States is fully prepared and ready to strike the Islamic Republic of Iran with a level of military terror, force and power not seen since World War II," Trump said.

data.title: Ceny pozemků letí vzhůru, rekordmanem je Jeseník
data.description: Nárůst zájmu o vlastní bydlení či o krátkodobé pronájmy žene vzhůru cenu stavebních pozemků. Zájemci se už soustředí i na dříve přehlížené lokality, kde tak ceny parcel za deset vzrostly i o stovky procent. Z dat projektu Realiťák roku a CEMAP vyplývá, že průměrná cena za metr čtvereční v roce 2016 činila 814 Kč/metr čtvereční, zatímco letos už vystoupala na 2 615 korun. Procentuální nárůst tak překračuje 220 procent.
data.translatedTitle: Land prices are soaring, Jeseník is the record holder
data.translatedDescription: The increase in interest in own housing or short-term rentals drives up the price of building land. Interested parties are already concentrating on previously overlooked locations, where the prices of plots for ten have risen by hundreds of percent. Data from the Realtor of the Year project and CEMAP show that the average price per square meter in 2016 was CZK 814/square meter, while this year it already rose to CZK 2,615. The percentage increase thus exceeds 220 percent.

data.title: „Jsme slavnější než Ježíš.“ Lennonovi ujel jazyk a Amerika pálila desky Beatles
data.description: „Nevím, co zmizí první – jestli rock’n’roll, nebo křesťanství,“ zamyslel se přesně před šedesáti lety John Lennon. Beatles ležel svět u nohou a kapela se chystala na turné po USA. Jenže Lennonův výrok na americkém Jihu podnítil nebývalou bouři odporu. Ku-klux-klan bil na poplach a desky Beatles mizely v ohni. Příběh skandálu vám přináší další díl seriálu Slavné fotografie.
data.translatedTitle: "We are more famous than Jesus." Lennon lost his tongue and America was burning Beatles records
data.translatedDescription: "I don't know which will disappear first - rock'n'roll or Christianity," thought John Lennon exactly sixty years ago. The Beatles had the world at their feet and the band was about to tour the US. But Lennon's statement sparked an unprecedented storm of opposition in the American South. The Ku Klux Klan was sounding the alarm and Beatles records were disappearing in the fire. The story of the scandal brings you another part of the series Famous photos.

data.title: Jaké palivo je nejlepší? A proč netankovat až po hrdlo? Manažerka Shellu vypráví
data.description: Je jednou z mála žen ve vysoké manažerské funkci v tradičně mužském oboru, jakým je petrolejářský průmysl. Markéta Jakoubková zodpovídá za kvalitu paliv Shell v Česku, na Slovensku a v dalších čtyřech evropských zemích. „Lidé znají Shell hlavně jako čerpací stanici, ale málokdo si za tím vším představí laboratoře, výzkum a technologii,“ říká specialistka na vývoj a kontrolu paliv, technologii aditiv, tedy látek, jež se do pohonných hmot přidávají, a kvalitu benzinu i nafty.
data.translatedTitle: What fuel is best? And why not fill up to the brim? Shell's manager tells
data.translatedDescription: She is one of the few women in a senior management position in a traditionally male-dominated field such as the petroleum industry. Markéta Jakoubková is responsible for the quality of Shell fuels in the Czech Republic, Slovakia and four other European countries. "People know Shell mainly as a gas station, but few people imagine the laboratories, research and technology behind it all," says the specialist in fuel development and control, additive technology, i.e. substances added to fuel, and the quality of gasoline and diesel.

data.title: Oddechla si, až když jí zavolal. Tíhu války v Íránu nesou i rodiny vojáků
data.description: Válečné konflikty zpravidla doléhají i za hranice napadeného či bránícího se státu. Jinak tomu není ani během války na Blízkém východě. Rodiny vojáků popisují, jak čelí bezmoci a strachu a s napětím i několik týdnů čekají, až jim jejich blízcí zavolají.
data.translatedTitle: She only breathed a sigh of relief when he called her. The families of soldiers are also bearing the brunt of the war in Iran
data.translatedDescription: War conflicts usually extend beyond the borders of the attacked or defending state. It is not different during the war in the Middle East. Soldiers' families describe how they face helplessness and fear and wait anxiously for weeks for their loved ones to call.

data.title: Britové si z politiky dělají legraci, volby rozhodne migrace, říká český velvyslanec
data.description: V domě číslo deset na londýnské Downing Street se v minulých dnech měnil už posedmé za poslední dekádu nájemník. Stává se Británie druhou Itálií, jak tamní obyvatelé vtipkují? „Příjemné jim to není,“ říká v rozhovoru pro iDNES.cz český velvyslanec v Londýně Václav Bartuška. Jak se podle něj proměnily česko-britské vztahy v posledních letech, kde jsou mezi oběma zeměmi výrazné rozdíly, a co je naopak sbližuje?
data.translatedTitle: The British make fun of politics, the election will be decided by migration, says the Czech ambassador
data.translatedDescription: House number ten on London's Downing Street has changed tenants for the seventh time in the past decade. Is Britain becoming a second Italy, as locals joke? "It's not pleasant for them," says Václav Bartuška, the Czech ambassador in London, in an interview for iDNES.cz. According to him, how have Czech-British relations changed in recent years, where are there significant differences between the two countries, and what, on the contrary, brings them closer together?

data.title: V Moskvě vybouchla po domácku vyrobená bomba. Exploze zabila tři lidi, další zranila
data.description: Explozi u luxusní restaurace v Moskvě, jež zabila tři lidi a dvě desítky dalších zranila, způsobila po domácku vyrobená výbušnina. Podle agentury TASS to oznámil Národní protiteroristický výbor. Zatím není jasné, zda šlo o politický motiv.
data.translatedTitle: A homemade bomb exploded in Moscow. The explosion killed three people and injured another
data.translatedDescription: An explosion at a luxury restaurant in Moscow, which killed three people and injured two dozen others, was caused by a home-made explosive. According to the TASS agency, this was announced by the National Anti-Terrorism Committee. It is not yet clear whether it was a political motive.

data.title: Na jihu Peru spadlo malé letadlo s turisty. Nepřežilo 13 lidí, včetně dvou pilotů
data.description: Při pádu malého letadla s turisty v sobotu na jihu Peru zemřelo 13 lidí, včetně dvou pilotů.. Národnost cestujících, kteří si letěli prohlédnout obrazce na planině Nazca, nezmínila. Podle nepotvrzených zpráv některých peruánských médií šlo o turisty ze Španělska, Itálie a Německa.
data.translatedTitle: Na jihu Peru spadlo malé letadlo s turisty. Nepřežilo 13 lidí, včetně dvou pilotů
data.translatedDescription: Thirteen people, including two pilots, died in the crash of a small plane carrying tourists on Saturday in southern Peru. She did not mention the nationality of the passengers who flew to see the figures on the Nazca plain. According to unconfirmed reports by some Peruvian media, they were tourists from Spain, Italy and Germany.

data.title: Experti k boji o Senát: ANO by pomohl „kanibalismus“, Grolich nemá strategii
data.description: Na začátku srpna se uzavírají kandidátní listiny pro podzimní volby do Senátu. Zatímco opozice spolupracuje zhruba v polovině obvodů, vládní strany jdou do voleb samostatně a na většině míst se utkají ANO s SPD. „Je otázka, zda byl prostor a čas hledat v ANO známé mediální tváře pro Senát. Podle zveřejněných jmen do toho příliš úsilí nešlo,“ hodnotí politolog Milan Školník z České zemědělské univerzity.
data.translatedTitle: Experti k boji o Senát: ANO by pomohl „kanibalismus“, Grolich nemá strategii
data.translatedDescription: At the beginning of August, the candidate lists for the fall Senate elections are closed. While the opposition cooperates in roughly half of the constituencies, the government parties go to the elections independently and in most places ANO will face the SPD. "The question is whether there was space and time to look for well-known media faces for the Senate in ANO. According to the published names, not much effort was put into it," assesses political scientist Milan Školník from the Czech University of Life Sciences.

data.title: Nehoda u Heřmanovy Huti krátce uzavřela dálnici D5. Zranili se dva lidé
data.description: Nehoda dvou osobních aut v sobotu odpoledne nakrátko uzavřela provoz ve směru na Plzeň na dálnici D5 u Heřmanovy Huti na Plzeňsku. Při nehodě se zranili dva lidé.
data.translatedTitle: Nehoda u Heřmanovy Huti krátce uzavřela dálnici D5. Zranili se dva lidé
data.translatedDescription: An accident involving two cars on Saturday afternoon briefly closed traffic in the direction of Pilsen on the D5 highway near Heřmanova Huta in the Pilsen Region. Two people were injured in the accident.

data.title: Italští mniši vyráběli kolu ještě před slavným Pembertonem. Ve Florencii našli recept
data.description: Třicet gramů kolových ořechů, deset gramů listů koky, jeden litr alkoholu. Vylouhujte a Coca-Cola je hotová. Nebo spíš její předchůdkyně. Italští mniši našli v archivech starobylé lékárny ve Florencii recept na „posilující vinný elixír“ z 19. století, který využívá stejné ingredience, jaké později využil americký lékárník John Pemberton pro svůj dnes už legendární nápoj.
data.translatedTitle: Italští mniši vyráběli kolu ještě před slavným Pembertonem. Ve Florencii našli recept
data.translatedDescription: Thirty grams of kola nuts, ten grams of coca leaves, one liter of alcohol. Infuse and Coca-Cola is ready. Or rather her predecessor. In the archives of an ancient pharmacy in Florence, Italian monks found a 19th-century recipe for a "fortifying wine elixir" that uses the same ingredients that American pharmacist John Pemberton later used for his now-legendary drink.

data.title: Moravu zasáhly prudké bouřky a krupobití. Po krátkém ochlazení přijdou další tropy
data.description: Víkend do Česka přinese částečné ochlazení. Na Moravě platí výstraha před silnými bouřkami a krupobitím. První silné udeřily v podvečer na Frýdecko-Místecku a na jihu Jihomoravského kraje. Od pondělí pak Česko zasáhne další vlna veder, která potrvá několik dní. V sobotu zaznamenali na šesti procentech českých stanic teplotní rekordy, všechny na východě republiky.
data.translatedTitle: Moravu zasáhly prudké bouřky a krupobití. Po krátkém ochlazení přijdou další tropy
data.translatedDescription: The weekend will bring partial cooling to the Czech Republic. In Moravia, there is a warning against strong storms and hail. The first strong ones struck in the early evening in Frýdecko-Místek and in the south of the South Moravian region. From Monday, another heat wave will hit the Czech Republic, which will last for several days. On Saturday, temperature records were set at six percent of Czech stations, all in the east of the republic.

data.title: Kropiči a pak vlnící se tanečnice. Horké ulice Brna rozproudil karnevalový průvod
data.description: Historické centrum Brna v sobotu odpoledne zaplavila atmosféra, za kterou lidé běžně musejí cestovat přes půl světa do brazilského Rio de Janeira. Ulicemi prošel karnevalový průvod s tanečnicemi v pestrobarevných kostýmech, bubeníky a bojovníky capoeiry. Procesí bylo vrcholem čtyřdenního Brasil festu věnovaného kultuře této jihoamerické země.
data.translatedTitle: Kropiči a pak vlnící se tanečnice. Horké ulice Brna rozproudil karnevalový průvod
data.translatedDescription: On Saturday afternoon, the historic center of Brno was flooded with an atmosphere for which people normally have to travel halfway around the world to Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. A carnival procession passed through the streets with dancers in colorful costumes, drummers and capoeira fighters. The procession was the highlight of the four-day Brasil Fest dedicated to the culture of this South American country.

data.title: V Itálii udeřilo nejsilnější zemětřesení za 40 let. Evakuovali stovky lidí, jsou i zranění
data.description: Téměř tři desítky zraněných si vyžádalo zemětřesení o síle 4,7, které v pátek večer zasáhlo oblast u Neapole v jižní Itálii. Pět lidí muselo být hospitalizováno. Kvůli otřesům, které poškodily několik domů, musely úřady evakuovat asi 300 lidí, informovaly v sobotu. Podle televize Sky TG24 šlo o nejsilnější zemětřesení v této oblasti za posledních čtyřicet let.
data.translatedTitle: V Itálii udeřilo nejsilnější zemětřesení za 40 let. Evakuovali stovky lidí, jsou i zranění
data.translatedDescription: Almost three dozen people were injured in a 4.7-magnitude earthquake that hit the area near Naples in southern Italy on Friday evening. Five people had to be hospitalized. Authorities had to evacuate about 300 people because of the tremors, which damaged several houses, they said on Saturday. According to Sky TG24, it was the strongest earthquake in the area in the last forty years.

data.title: Černý trh s cigaretami roste. Český rozpočet loni přišel o šest miliard
data.description: Padělané a pašované cigarety tvořily loni v Česku necelých devět procent z celkové spotřeby, což odpovídá asi miliardě kusů cigaret. Oproti roku 2024 podíl narostl o 0,8 procentního bodu. Spotřeba legálních cigaret v ČR přitom klesá, vyplývá z údajů Sekce pro boj s nelegálním trhem Českého sdružení pro značkové výrobky. Český stát podle ní kvůli nelegálním cigaretám loni přišel o zhruba šest miliard korun na daních.
data.translatedTitle: Černý trh s cigaretami roste. Český rozpočet loni přišel o šest miliard
data.translatedDescription: Counterfeit and smuggled cigarettes made up less than nine percent of the total consumption in the Czech Republic last year, which corresponds to about a billion cigarettes. Compared to 2024, the share increased by 0.8 percentage points. At the same time, the consumption of legal cigarettes in the Czech Republic is decreasing, according to data from the Section for Combating the Illegal Market of the Czech Association for Branded Products. According to her, the Czech state lost about six billion crowns in taxes last year because of illegal cigarettes.

data.title: Na Bulovku převezli ženu s podezřením na nebezpečnou nemoc. Vrátila se z Ugandy
data.description: Fakultní nemocnice Bulovka v Praze v sobotu odpoledne přijala ženu s podezřením na některou z vysoce nebezpečných nákaz po návratu z Ugandy. Řekla to mluvčí nemocnice Eva Stolejda Libigerová. Pravděpodobnost nákazy ženy je podle ministerstva zdravotnictví (MZd) velmi nízká a veřejnosti podle něj nehrozí žádné riziko. Výsledky testů budou podle ředitele Odboru ochrany veřejného zdraví MZd Matyáše Fošuma známé zřejmě v neděli.
data.translatedTitle: Na Bulovku převezli ženu s podezřením na nebezpečnou nemoc. Vrátila se z Ugandy
data.translatedDescription: On Saturday afternoon, the Bulovka University Hospital in Prague admitted a woman with suspicion of one of the highly dangerous infections after returning from Uganda. Hospital spokesperson Eva Stolejda Libigerová said it. According to the Ministry of Health (MZd), the probability of infection of the woman is very low and, according to him, there is no risk to the public. According to the director of the Public Health Protection Department of the Ministry of Health, Matyáš Fošum, the results of the tests will probably be known on Sunday.

data.title: Bird flu kills 13,000 seal pups on remote Australian island
data.description:
SYDNEY: A pathogenic strain of bird flu killed more than 13,000 elephant seal pups after infecting a breeding colony on a sub-Antarctic volcanic island, Australian scientists said Thursday.
	Researchers found the remote Heard and McDonald Islands littered with seal carcasses when they arrived on a research expedition in October 2025.
	Genetic testing confirmed the contagious H5 bird flu strain had killed seals, penguins and birds living on the rocky outcrop — the first time it had been detected in one of Australia’s external territories.

data.title: Australia says net migration down as far-right popularity surges
data.description:
SYDNEY: Australia’s immigration levels fell last year, official data showed on Thursday, as its center-left government seeks to combat an ascendent far-right riding a wave of public discontent over soaring housing prices and cost of living.
	Net overseas migration added 301,000 people to Australia’s population of 28 million last year, Canberra’s Bureau of Statistics reported.
	Immigration minister Tony Burke said the figure was down nine percent from a year earlier and 45 percent lower than a post-Covid peak in 2023.

data.title: Kane double fires England World Cup bid as Ronaldo’s Portugal stumble
data.description:

data.title: Oil falls to 3-1/2-month low after US, Iran sign ceasefire deal
data.description:
BEIJING/SINGAPORE: Oil prices ​fell by more than $2 per barrel on Thursday after the US and Iran signed an interim agreement that ‌would end the Iran war, reopen the Strait of Hormuz and waive US sanctions on Tehran’s oil, boosting the oil supply outlook.

	Brent crude futures were down $2.14, or 2.69 percent, at $77.41 a barrel as of 09:16 a.m. Saudi time, and US West Texas Intermediate fell $2.36, or 3.07 percent, to $74.43 a barrel.

data.title: Daily Telegraph columnist argues Saudi Arabia should join G7
data.description:
DUBAI: Saudi Arabia should be invited to join the Group of Seven nations as the organization adapts to a changing global order, according to a column published in the Daily Telegraph by former UK prime ministerial representative to Saudi Arabia Ken Costa.

	Costa argued that while the G7 was created in the aftermath of the 1970s oil crisis, the world has changed dramatically since then, with new economic and geopolitical powers emerging. Despite those shifts, he said the group remains largely unchanged and no longer reflects the realities of global influence.

data.title: Bangassou : la hausse des tarifs des moto-taxis mécontente les usagers
data.description: Fr : Sa : À Bangassou, dans le Mbomou, les usagers des moto-taxis dénoncent l’augmentation du coût du transport urbain. Les conducteurs expliquent cette hausse par l’augmentation du prix du carburant, tandis que les importateurs l’attribuent au mauvais état des routes, qui alourdit les coûts d’approvisionnement. Reportage de Bolyvice Massambaye. L’article Bangassou : la hausse des tarifs des moto-taxis mécontente les usagers est apparu en premier sur Radio Ndeke Luka .

data.title: Félix Tshisekedi inaugure le nouveau palais de justice de Lubumbashi
data.description: La ville de Lubumbashi (Haut-Katanga) dispose d’un nouveau palais de justice. Cette infrastructure, inaugurée samedi 1er aout par la President de la République, Félix Tshisekedi, va abriter la cour d’appel, le tribunal de grande instance, le tribunal de commerce, le tribunal pour enfants et d’autres juridictions.
data.translatedTitle: Félix Tshisekedi inaugure le nouveau palais de justice de Lubumbashi
data.translatedDescription: The city of Lubumbashi (Haut-Katanga) has a new courthouse. This infrastructure, inaugurated on Saturday August 1 by the President of the Republic, Félix Tshisekedi, will house the court of appeal, the high court, the commercial court, the children's court and other courts.

data.title: Démolitions à Kinshasa : colère des habitants de la 18eme Rue Limete contre Leon Mulumba
data.description: La tension a été vive samedi 1er aout sur la 18ᵉ Rue à Limete à la suite des opérations de démolition menée dans cette commune de Kinshasa. Sur terrain, des habitants accusent le ministre provincial de l’Environnement, Léon Mulumba, d’ordonner des destructions au-delà du périmètre prévu.
data.translatedTitle: Demolitions in Kinshasa: anger of the residents of 18th Rue Limete against Leon Mulumba
data.translatedDescription: Tension was high on Saturday August 1 on 18th Street in Limete following demolition operations carried out in this commune of Kinshasa. On the ground, residents accuse the provincial Minister of the Environment, Léon Mulumba, of ordering destruction beyond the planned perimeter.

data.title: Évasion de tous les détenus de la prison de Luebo au Kasaï
data.description: Au moins 50 détenus se sont évadés dans la nuit de jeudi à vendredi 31 juillet de la prison de Luebo, dans la province du Kasaï. Toute la maison carcérale est restée vide. L'information a été confirmée ce samedi 1er août par l'administrateur du territoire, Jean Tshiawuke wa Tshiawuke, qui évoque une évasion « bien préparée ».
data.translatedTitle: Escape of all inmates from Luebo prison in Kasai
data.translatedDescription: At least 50 detainees escaped during the night of Thursday to Friday July 31 from Luebo prison, in Kasai province. The entire prison house remained empty. The information was confirmed this Saturday August 1 by the administrator of the territory, Jean Tshiawuke wa Tshiawuke, who spoke of a “well prepared” escape.

data.title: Raphaël Katebe Katoto réserve au chef de l’État la « primeur » du rapport de ses consultations à Lubumbashi
data.description: Au terme de ses consultations ce 1er août, avec différentes composantes de la population à Lubumbashi, Raphaël Katebe Katoto se dit satisfait des échanges menés avec les forces vives du Haut-Katanga. Il affirme avoir recueilli plusieurs préoccupations de la population et annonce qu’il réservera la primeur des résultats au président de la République, Félix Tshisekedi.
data.translatedTitle: Raphaël Katebe Katoto reserves for the Head of State the “first” of the report of his consultations in Lubumbashi
data.translatedDescription: At the end of his consultations on August 1, with different components of the population in Lubumbashi, Raphaël Katebe Katoto said he was satisfied with the exchanges carried out with the active forces of Haut-Katanga. He claims to have collected several concerns from the population and announces that he will reserve the first of the results for the President of the Republic, Félix Tshisekedi.

data.title: La MONUSCO lance un projet d'engagement communautaire pour freiner l'épidémie d'Ebola à Djugu
data.description: Après avoir renforcé les capacités logistiques des équipes médicales, la MONUSCO mise désormais sur la confiance et l'implication directe des populations pour stopper la propagation de la maladie à virus Ebola. Un nouveau projet de sensibilisation a été officiellement lancé ce jeudi 30 juillet à Miala, dans le territoire de Djugu, en Ituri.
data.translatedTitle: MONUSCO launches community engagement project to curb Ebola outbreak in Djugu
data.translatedDescription: After strengthening the logistical capacities of medical teams, MONUSCO is now banking on the trust and direct involvement of populations to stop the spread of Ebola virus disease. A new awareness project was officially launched this Thursday, July 30 in Miala, in the territory of Djugu, in Ituri.

data.title: Journée des parents à Bunia : entre hommage, responsabilité familiale et devoir de mémoire
data.description: Célébration ce 1er août en République démocratique du Congo, de la Journée nationale des parents. A Bunia en Ituri, au-delà de l’hommage rendu aux pères et aux mères, cette commémoration est perçue comme une invitation à réfléchir aux responsabilités liées à la parentalité.
data.translatedTitle: Parents' Day in Bunia: between tribute, family responsibility and duty to remember
data.translatedDescription: Celebration this August 1st in the Democratic Republic of Congo, of National Parents' Day. In Bunia in Ituri, beyond the tribute paid to fathers and mothers, this commemoration is seen as an invitation to reflect on the responsibilities linked to parenthood.

data.title: 1er août à Kinshasa : les cimetières pris d’assaut à l’occasion de la Journée des parents et du souvenir des disparus
data.description: De nombreuses familles se sont rendues, ce samedi, dans les cimetières de Kinshasa pour rendre hommage à leurs proches décédés, à l'occasion de la Journée des parents et du souvenir des disparus, célébrée chaque 1er août en RDC. Recueillement, entretien des sépultures et prières ont rythmé cette journée marquée par une forte affluence dans les principaux cimetières de la capitale.
data.translatedTitle: August 1 in Kinshasa: cemeteries stormed on the occasion of Parents' Day and the remembrance of the missing
data.translatedDescription: Many families went this Saturday to the cemeteries of Kinshasa to pay tribute to their deceased loved ones, on the occasion of Parents' Day and Remembrance of the Missing, celebrated every August 1 in the DRC. Collection, maintenance of graves and prayers punctuated this day marked by a large crowd in the main cemeteries of the capital.

data.title: Avis contrastés autour des consultations de Raphaël Katebe Katoto sur le « vivre-ensemble » dans le Haut-Katanga
data.description: De retour à Lubumbashi (Haut-Katanga) après plusieurs années d’absence, le notable katangais Raphaël Katebe Katoto mène, depuis le jeudi 30 juillet 2026 à l’hôtel Pullman Grand Karavia, une série de consultations avec les forces vives locales. Selon certaines sources, cette démarche, axée sur la cohésion sociale et les défis provinciaux, suscite autant d'espoir que de questionnements politiques au sein de l'opinion locale.
data.translatedTitle: Contrasting opinions surrounding Raphaël Katebe Katoto's consultations on “living together” in Haut-Katanga
data.translatedDescription: Returning to Lubumbashi (Haut-Katanga) after several years of absence, the notable Katangese Raphaël Katebe Katoto has been leading, since Thursday July 30, 2026 at the Pullman Grand Karavia hotel, a series of consultations with local leaders. According to certain sources, this approach, focused on social cohesion and provincial challenges, arouses as much hope as political questions within local opinion.

data.title: A Goma,  la Journée internationale de la femme africaine met en lumière la résilience et l’entrepreneuriat féminin
data.description: À l’occasion de la Journée internationale de la femme africaine célébrée le 31 juillet, la ville de Goma, dans le Nord-Kivu, s'est mobilisée pour honorer la force et l’esprit d'initiative des femmes de la région. Organisées par la Synergie des Femmes pour la Paix et la Sécurité, les activités ont mis en lumière la capacité des Congolaises à surmonter un contexte sécuritaire particulièrement éprouvant selon des sources concordantes.
data.translatedTitle: In Goma, International African Women’s Day highlights resilience and female entrepreneurship
data.translatedDescription: On the occasion of International African Women's Day celebrated on July 31, the city of Goma, in North Kivu, mobilized to honor the strength and spirit of initiative of women in the region. Organized by the Synergy of Women for Peace and Security, the activities highlighted the capacity of Congolese women to overcome a particularly trying security context according to consistent sources.

data.title: ‘Our hearts are with everyone affected’ — Shatta Wale’s management after ShattaFest UK tragedy
data.description:
Shatta Wale's management has expressed deep sorrow following the cancellation of ShattaFest UK after a stampede at the event venue in London, saying its thoughts are with those affected while investigations continue.

In a statement issued after the incident, the management said the decision to cancel the concert was taken because the safety of patrons remained the top priority.

"It is with a very heavy heart that we address the unfortunate events surrounding SHATTAFEST UK," the statement said.

data.title: Tech for Girls founder Johanna Swaniker calls for investment to expand digital skills programme in Ghana
data.description:
The Founder of the Heritage and Cultural Society of Africa (HACSA), Ambassador Johanna Swaniker, has called for increased financial and institutional support to expand the Tech for Girls programme, saying greater investment is needed to equip more young women with digital skills for the future of work.

Speaking at the graduation ceremony for the programme's fourth cohort, Ambassador Swaniker said funding remains the biggest challenge to scaling the initiative despite growing demand for training in coding, innovation and digital technology.

data.title: NSMQ 2026: Mim SHS, Serwaa Kesse Girls’ and Presec Bechem book national championship spots
data.description:
The battle for places at the 2026 National Science and Maths Quiz (NSMQ) national championship has ended in the Ahafo Region, with three schools earning qualification after a day of intense competition.

Serwaa Kesse Girls’ Senior High School opened the contest with a commanding performance, topping the first round of qualifiers with 37 points to book their place at the national championship.

data.title: Mahama orders roadmap to expand TOR’s refining capacity to 100,000 barrels a day
data.description:
President John Dramani Mahama has directed the Minister for Energy and Green Transition, John Abdulai Jinapor, together with the Board and management of the Tema Oil Refinery (TOR), to develop a strategic roadmap to expand the refinery's production capacity to 100,000 barrels of crude oil per day.

The directive was announced on Saturday, August 1, during the commissioning of the refurbished refinery at the Tema Industrial Enclave, where the President outlined an ambitious vision to transform the state-owned refinery into a key driver of Ghana's industrialisation agenda.

data.title: Trump reaffirms U.S. recognition of Morocco’s sovereignty over Western Sahara
data.description: "The United States is unequivocal: we recognise Moroccan sovereignty over Western Sahara and support Morocco's serious, credible, and realistic Autonomy Proposal as the only basis for a just and lasting solution. data.title: Court of Appeal decision on Sedina raises questions about prosecution standards and appeal process – Gary Nimako
data.description:
Private legal practitioner Gary Nimako has raised concerns about aspects of the Court of Appeal's decision to overturn a criminal conviction of the former Chief Executive of the Microfinance and Small Loans Centre (MASLOC), Sedina Tamakloe-Attionu, arguing that while some parts of the judgment are legally sound, others appear to impose an unusually high burden on prosecutors.

Speaking during a discussion on JoyNews’ Newsfile programme, Nimako explained that every criminal trial begins with investigations conducted by law enforcement agencies before a case is brought before the courts.

data.title: Court of Appeal ruling on Sedina could reshape criminal prosecutions, says Inusah Fuseini
data.description:
Former Member of Parliament and lawyer Inusah Fuseini has described the Court of Appeal's decision overturning the criminal conviction of Sedina Tamakloe-Attionu, the former Chief Executive of the Microfinance and Small Loans Centre (MASLOC), as a landmark judgment that could significantly influence the conduct of criminal prosecutions in Ghana.

Speaking on Newsfile, Inusah Fuseini said the ruling is likely to compel prosecutors to exercise greater diligence in preparing and presenting criminal cases.

Attendue par les voyageurs comme par les acteurs économiques, cette reprise dépasse le simple retour d'une desserte commerciale. data.title: Tablas posiciones Premundial Sub-20: Honduras fuera, clasificados y eliminados
data.description: La fase de grupos del Clasificatorio Sub-20 de la Concacaf finalizó este sábado 01 de agosto y ya se conoce a las selecciones que estarán en la siguiente ronda del torneo que se está disputando en México. Honduras sufrió un duro golpe en la última fecha. La Bicolor fue superada por Panamá con una abultada goleada de 0-4, resultado que lo dejó fuera de la competencia. La 'H' también se despide de los Juegos Olímpicos y del Mundial de esta categoría juvenil. En el Grupo A, Estados Unidos lideró con paso perfecto y selló su pase a la siguiente ronda con 9 puntos y le siguió Haití con 6 unidades. Cuba quedó fuera con 3 puntos y el último lugar lo ocupó El Salvador con tres derrotas. Por su parte, en el encasillado B, México se quedó con la primera plaza tras alcanzar las 9 unidades. El segundo puesto fue para Costa Rica con 6 y Guatemala clasificó a la otra fase como uno de los mejores terceros con 3; los chapines pasan por mejor diferencia de goles. Por último el Grupo C. En este encasillado, Canadá y Jamaica aseguraron su pase a los cuartos de final tras sumar ambos 5 puntos. Con el tercer lugar se que quedó Panamá con 4 y Honduras fue cuarto con apenas 1. Los clasificados son: Estados Unidos, Haití, México, Costa Rica, Guatemala, Canadá, Jamaica y Panamá. Los eliminados: Cuba, El Salvador, Antigua y Barbuda y Honduras.
data.translatedTitle: U-20 World Cup position tables: Honduras out, classified and eliminated
data.translatedDescription: The group stage of the Concacaf U-20 Qualifier ended this Saturday, August 1, and the teams that will be in the next round of the tournament being played in Mexico are already known. Honduras suffered a hard blow on the last date. La Bicolor was surpassed by Panama with a resounding 0-4 win, a result that left them out of the competition. The 'H' also says goodbye to the Olympic Games and the World Cup in this youth category. In Group A, the United States led with a perfect pace and sealed their pass to the next round with 9 points and Haiti followed with 6 points. Cuba was left out with 3 points and the last place was occupied by El Salvador with three defeats. For its part, in box B, Mexico took first place after reaching 9 units. Second place went to Costa Rica with 6 and Guatemala qualified for the other phase as one of the best third parties with 3; the chapines go through with a better goal difference. Finally, Group C. In this category, Canada and Jamaica secured their place in the quarterfinals after both adding 5 points. With third place, Panama was left with 4 and Honduras was fourth with just 1. The classified are: United States, Haiti, Mexico, Costa Rica, Guatemala, Canada, Jamaica and Panama. Those eliminated: Cuba, El Salvador, Antigua and Barbuda and Honduras.

data.title: Don Lenin pide disculpas y aclara lo que pasó con el perro arrastrado en Choloma
data.description: Don Lenin, propietario del perro que fue captado en un video siendo arrastrado por un vehículo en Choloma , Cortés, pidió disculpas a la población y explicó su versión de los hechos luego de que la Policía Nacional lo requiriera para investigación tras la difusión de las imágenes en redes sociales. El ciudadano se presentó ante la Dirección Policial de Investigaciones (DPI), donde brindó declaraciones sobre lo ocurrido y aseguró que el perro se encuentra en su vivienda, bajo cuidado, mientras se recupera. “Yo le pido disculpas a la población, a las redes sociales, porque ellos saben que si actué mal, pero el perrito lo tengo en la casa y ahí lo vamos a recuperar”, manifestó Don Lenin. Durante la explicación del procedimiento, un representante de la DPI indicó que un equipo de investigadores realizó inspecciones en la vivienda del ciudadano, el vehículo y el animal para verificar las condiciones en las que se encontraba el perro . Según la información proporcionada por la Policía, tras la revisión se determinó que el perro no presentaba lesiones. El caso fue consultado con el fiscal de turno, quien habría indicado que, al no existir daños en el animal, Don Lenin no podía ser requerido ni detenido. El propietario del perro explicó que, luego de detener el vehículo, se trasladó a realizar unas diligencias y que posteriormente el animal fue revisado. Afirmó que actualmente permanece en su casa y que se encuentra recuperándose. El caso generó una amplia reacción en redes sociales luego de que circulara el video del perro siendo arrastrado por un carro en Choloma, provocando reclamos de ciudadanos y defensores de los animales. Mientras tanto, Don Lenin pidió comprensión a la población y reiteró sus disculpas por lo ocurrido, al tiempo que aseguró que continuará cuidando al perro en su vivienda.
data.translatedTitle: Don Lenin apologizes and clarifies what happened to the dog dragged in Choloma
data.translatedDescription: Don Lenin, owner of the dog that was captured on video being dragged by a vehicle in Choloma, Cortés, apologized to the population and explained his version of the events after the National Police requested him for investigation after the images were disseminated on social networks. The citizen appeared before the Police Investigation Directorate (DPI), where he gave statements about what happened and assured that the dog is in his home, under care, while he recovers. “I apologize to the population, to social networks, because they know that I did act badly, but I have the dog in the house and we are going to recover it there,” said Don Lenin. During the explanation of the procedure, a representative of the DPI indicated that a team of investigators carried out inspections of the citizen's home, the vehicle and the animal to verify the conditions in which the dog was found. According to the information provided by the Police, after the inspection it was determined that the dog had no injuries. The case was consulted with the prosecutor on duty, who would have indicated that, since there was no damage to the animal, Don Lenin could not be required or detained. The dog's owner explained that, after stopping the vehicle, he went to carry out some errands and that the animal was subsequently checked. He stated that he currently remains at home and is recovering. The case generated a wide reaction on social networks after the video of the dog being dragged by a car in Choloma circulated, provoking complaints from citizens and animal defenders. Meanwhile, Don Lenin asked the population for understanding and reiterated his apologies for what happened, while ensuring that he will continue to care for the dog in his home.

data.title: Sin ser acusado, queda libre hombre que arrastró un perro con su carro en Choloma
data.description: El hombre que fue detenido por la Policía Nacional tras ser grabado arrastrando a un perro con su vehículo en el sector de Choloma, Cortés, fue dejado en libertad, según denunció un representante de la organización Mascotas en Adopción. La liberación habría ocurrido luego de que un fiscal de turno determinara, tras una inspección, que el animal no presentaba lesiones. De acuerdo con la denuncia de la organización, el ciudadano fue detenido por agentes policiales luego de que el video del hecho se viralizara en redes sociales y generara indignación entre ciudadanos y defensores de los animales. El representante de Mascotas en Adopción explicó que acudieron a la posta policial de Choloma para conocer la actualización del caso y que fueron informados sobre el procedimiento realizado por las autoridades. Según su versión, la Policía trasladó al detenido y notificó al fiscal de turno sobre la captura. Posteriormente, se habría ordenado una inspección en la vivienda del ciudadano para verificar las condiciones en las que se encontraba el perro . Según relató el representante, tras la inspección y el envío de fotografías al fiscal, se determinó que el animal no presentaba lesiones y que no se continuarían acciones contra el ciudadano, quien quedó en libertad. La organización cuestionó la decisión y pidió al Ministerio Público dar seguimiento al caso, al considerar que el hecho captado en video debía tener una investigación más amplia. El caso continúa generando reacciones entre la población, luego de que las imágenes del perro siendo arrastrado por un vehículo en Choloma provocaran reclamos de ciudadanos que exigen protección y respeto hacia los animales.
data.translatedTitle: Without being accused, the man who dragged a dog with his car in Choloma is free
data.translatedDescription: The man who was detained by the National Police after being recorded dragging a dog with his vehicle in the Choloma sector, Cortés, was released, according to a representative of the Pets for Adoption organization. The release would have occurred after a prosecutor on duty determined, after an inspection, that the animal had no injuries. According to the organization's complaint, the citizen was detained by police officers after the video of the event went viral on social networks and generated outrage among citizens and animal defenders. The representative of Pets for Adoption explained that they went to the Choloma police station to find out the update on the case and that they were informed about the procedure carried out by the authorities. According to his version, the Police transferred the detainee and notified the prosecutor on duty about the capture. Subsequently, an inspection of the citizen's home would have been ordered to verify the conditions in which the dog was found. According to the representative, after inspection and sending photographs to the prosecutor, it was determined that the animal had no injuries and that no further action would be taken against the citizen, who was released. The organization questioned the decision and asked the Public Ministry to follow up on the case, considering that the event captured on video should have a broader investigation. The case continues to generate reactions among the population, after images of the dog being dragged by a vehicle in Choloma provoked complaints from citizens demanding protection and respect for animals.

data.title: Kevin Padilla es encontrado sin vida dentro de una bolsa en Sonaguera, Colón
data.description: Las autoridades identificaron el cuerpo de Kevin Javier Padilla Aguilar , conocido como “Pelo”, quien fue encontrado sin vida dentro de una bolsa y en estado de descomposición el viernes 31 de julio en el sector La Cubana, comunidad La Quebrada, El Guineo, en Sonaguera, Colón. El hallazgo ocurrió luego de que pobladores alertaran sobre la presencia de un cadáver en la zona. De acuerdo con información preliminar, Padilla Aguilar había sido reportado como desaparecido desde el pasado martes, por lo que sus familiares comenzaron una búsqueda hasta conocer sobre el hallazgo del cuerpo. La víctima residía en la comunidad de El Chorro, en Sonaguera . Familiares y personas allegadas llegaron al lugar para realizar el reconocimiento del cuerpo y acompañar el proceso correspondiente tras la confirmación de su identidad. Según los reportes iniciales, el cadáver fue localizado dentro de una bolsa y presentaba un avanzado estado de descomposición, por lo que las autoridades realizaron las diligencias para determinar las circunstancias del hecho. Miembros de la Policía Nacional se desplazaron hasta el sector donde fue encontrado el cuerpo para confirmar el hallazgo y comenzar con las investigaciones relacionadas con la muerte de Padilla Aguilar. Posteriormente, el cuerpo fue trasladado hacia la comunidad de El Chorro, donde familiares esperaban darle sepultura y despedir al joven conocido como “Pelo”. Hasta el momento, las autoridades no han establecido el móvil del crimen ni han informado sobre personas detenidas relacionadas con la muerte de Kevin Javier Padilla Aguilar.
data.translatedTitle: Kevin Padilla is found lifeless inside a bag in Sonaguera, Colón
data.translatedDescription: The authorities identified the body of Kevin Javier Padilla Aguilar, known as “Pelo”, who was found lifeless inside a bag and in a state of decomposition on Friday, July 31 in the La Cubana sector, La Quebrada community, El Guineo, in Sonaguera, Colón. The discovery occurred after residents alerted about the presence of a body in the area. According to preliminary information, Padilla Aguilar had been reported missing since last Tuesday, so his relatives began a search until they learned about the discovery of the body. The victim resided in the community of El Chorro, in Sonaguera. Relatives and close people arrived at the scene to recognize the body and accompany the corresponding process after confirming his identity. According to initial reports, the body was located inside a bag and was in an advanced state of decomposition, so the authorities carried out procedures to determine the circumstances of the incident. Members of the National Police traveled to the sector where the body was found to confirm the discovery and begin investigations related to the death of Padilla Aguilar. Later, the body was taken to the community of El Chorro, where relatives hoped to bury and say goodbye to the young man known as “Pelo.” So far, the authorities have not established the motive for the crime nor have they reported on any people detained in connection with the death of Kevin Javier Padilla Aguilar.

data.title: ¡El arma estaba cargada! Condenan a joven por matar a su amiga en juego de ruleta rusa
data.description: Omarion Horne , de 23 años, fue condenado a prisión tras declararse culpable de homicidio involuntario por la muerte de Rachel Counts , de 23 años, ocurrida en octubre de 2025 durante un juego de ruleta rusa en una vivienda de Cincinnati, en el condado de Hamilton, Estados Unidos. Según la Oficina del Fiscal del Condado de Hamilton, el hecho ocurrió mientras Horne y un grupo de amigos se encontraban jugando cartas en una reunión. Durante el encuentro, el joven manipuló un arma de fuego y posteriormente disparó contra Counts. Los fiscales informaron que Horne tomó un revólver, retiró una bala del cilindro y propuso jugar a la ruleta rusa . Luego apuntó primero hacia sí mismo y después hacia la víctima, momento en el que accionó el arma y el disparo impactó en el pecho de Counts. Equipos de emergencia llegaron hasta la vivienda ubicada en el vecindario Winton Hills, en Cincinnati, tras reportarse el tiroteo. Sin embargo, la joven fue declarada muerta en el lugar. Inicialmente, Horne enfrentaba un cargo más grave, pero posteriormente aceptó declararse culpable de homicidio involuntario. Tras el acuerdo judicial, un juez lo condenó a una pena de entre 10 y 14.5 años de prisión. Durante la audiencia inicial, Horne fue visto afectado emocionalmente mientras los fiscales expusieron los detalles del caso y la forma en que ocurrió el disparo que terminó con la vida de Counts. Connie Pillich, fiscal del condado de Hamilton, calificó el caso como una tragedia y recordó que las armas de fuego no deben ser utilizadas como parte de juegos o manipuladas de manera irresponsable. “Lo que comenzó como una reunión entre amigos terminó con una joven perdiendo la vida porque alguien trató un arma cargada como un juego ”, expresó Pillich, según la información proporcionada por la fiscalía.
data.translatedTitle: The gun was loaded! Young man sentenced for killing his friend in a game of Russian roulette
data.translatedDescription: Omarion Horne, 23, was sentenced to prison after pleading guilty to involuntary manslaughter for the death of Rachel Counts, 23, which occurred in October 2025 during a game of Russian roulette at a home in Cincinnati, Hamilton County, United States. According to the Hamilton County Prosecutor's Office, the incident occurred while Horne and a group of friends were playing cards at a gathering. During the encounter, the young man handled a firearm and subsequently shot Counts. Prosecutors reported that Horne took a revolver, removed a bullet from the cylinder, and proposed playing Russian roulette. He then pointed first at himself and then at the victim, at which point he activated the weapon and the shot hit Counts in the chest. Emergency teams arrived at the home located in the Winton Hills neighborhood in Cincinnati after the shooting was reported. However, the young woman was pronounced dead at the scene. Horne initially faced a more serious charge, but later agreed to plead guilty to involuntary manslaughter. After the judicial agreement, a judge sentenced him to a sentence of between 10 and 14.5 years in prison. During the initial hearing, Horne was emotionally shaken as prosecutors laid out the details of the case and how the shooting that ended Counts' life occurred. Connie Pillich, Hamilton County Prosecutor, described the case as a tragedy and reminded that firearms should not be used as part of games or handled irresponsibly. “What started as a meeting between friends ended with a young woman losing her life because someone treated a loaded gun like a game,” Pillich said, according to information provided by the prosecution.

data.title: Detienen a hombre acusado de arrastrar a un perro con su carro en Choloma, Cortés
data.description: La Policía Nacional detuvo este sábado al hombre denunciado por presuntamente arrastrar a un perro con su vehículo en la colonia López Arellano, a la salida de Cerro Verde, en Choloma , Cortés. El hecho quedó registrado en videos que se difundieron en redes sociales y provocaron indignación entre ciudadanos. El sospechoso fue ubicado y requerido por agentes policiales, por lo que permanece bajo custodia en la posta de Choloma mientras avanzan las investigaciones sobre el presunto caso de maltrato animal . Las imágenes muestran al perro siendo arrastrado por un vehículo en el sector y, posteriormente, al conductor subiendo al animal al baúl del automóvil, sujetándolo de una oreja, mientras algunas personas reclamaban por lo ocurrido. Tras la detención, fiscales se preparan para trasladarse a la vivienda del ciudadano con el objetivo de verificar el estado del perro y realizar las diligencias correspondientes dentro del proceso investigativo. El caso generó una fuerte reacción en redes sociales, donde pobladores y defensores de los animales exigieron que se esclarezca lo ocurrido y que se apliquen las medidas legales correspondientes. Aunque el detenido podría enfrentar cargos por presunto maltrato animal , serán las autoridades competentes las que determinen las responsabilidades conforme avance la investigación. La Policía Nacional mantiene bajo custodia al ciudadano mientras el Ministerio Público realiza las diligencias para establecer las circunstancias del hecho y conocer la condición del animal involucrado.
data.translatedTitle: They arrest a man accused of dragging a dog with his car in Choloma, Cortés
data.translatedDescription: This Saturday, the National Police arrested the man reported for allegedly dragging a dog with his vehicle in the López Arellano neighborhood, at the exit of Cerro Verde, in Choloma, Cortés. The event was recorded in videos that were spread on social networks and caused outrage among citizens. The suspect was located and required by police officers, so he remains in custody at the Choloma post while investigations into the alleged case of animal abuse continue. The images show the dog being dragged by a vehicle in the sector and, later, the driver lifting the animal into the trunk of the car, holding it by one ear, while some people complained about what happened. After the arrest, prosecutors prepare to go to the citizen's home with the aim of verifying the condition of the dog and carrying out the corresponding procedures within the investigative process. The case generated a strong reaction on social networks, where residents and animal defenders demanded that what happened be clarified and that the corresponding legal measures be applied. Although the detainee could face charges for alleged animal abuse, the competent authorities will determine responsibilities as the investigation progresses. The National Police keeps the citizen in custody while the Public Ministry carries out the procedures to establish the circumstances of the incident and find out the condition of the animal involved.

data.title: Honduras, humillada: adiós al Mundial Sub-20 y a los Juegos Olímpicos
data.description: La Selección Sub-20 de Honduras firmó una de las noches más dolorosas de los últimos años y consumó un nuevo fracaso internacional al caer de forma estrepitosa por 4-0 ante Panamá, resultado que la dejó eliminada del Premundial de Concacaf y, con ello, sin posibilidades de clasificar a la próxima Copa del Mundo Sub-20 ni a los Juegos Olímpicos de Los Ángeles 2028. La Bicolor llegó al Estadio Universitario BUAP de Puebla, México , con la ilusión intacta y dependiendo de sí misma para avanzar a los cuartos de final del certamen. El panorama era claro: ganar significaba seguir con vida y mantener encendido el sueño mundialista. Sin embargo, la realidad fue completamente distinta. Honduras fue superada con autoridad por una selección panameña que aprovechó cada error, golpeó en los momentos claves y terminó humillando a un rival que se desmoronó por completo. El pitazo final dejó imágenes de tristeza, impotencia y frustración entre los futbolistas hondureños, conscientes de que dejaron escapar una oportunidad histórica. Panamá, por el contrario, celebró con justicia un triunfo que lo instaló en la siguiente ronda del campeonato. Con esta eliminación, Honduras vuelve a quedarse fuera de una Copa del Mundo Sub-20 y también pierde la posibilidad de luchar por uno de los boletos hacia los próximos Juegos Olímpicos, profundizando la crisis que atraviesan las selecciones menores del país. La derrota también vuelve a poner en el centro de las críticas al entrenador Orlando López, quien nuevamente no pudo cumplir los objetivos al frente de una selección juvenil hondureña. El estratega cierra otro proceso marcado por la decepción y los cuestionamientos, mientras el fútbol catracho suma un nuevo capítulo de frustración en las categorías formativas. El encuentro comenzó con una Honduras valiente, que intentó imponer condiciones desde los primeros minutos. Apenas al minuto 3, Mike Arana protagonizó una gran jugada individual por la banda, envió un centro peligroso, pero la defensa panameña reaccionó a tiempo para despejar el balón antes de que llegara un atacante hondureño. La Bicolor siguió insistiendo y al minuto 7 volvió a generar peligro. Nuevamente Arana desbordó por el costado y colocó un centro preciso al corazón del área, donde David Flores llegó con intención de rematar, aunque no logró conectar el esférico cuando parecía que se abría el marcador. Cuando Honduras daba señales de controlar el compromiso, comenzaron a llegar las malas noticias. Al minuto 12, Arbin Medrano sufrió una lesión que le impidió continuar en el partido y obligó al cuerpo técnico a realizar la primera modificación del encuentro. En su lugar ingresó Nicolás Balbas. Pese al golpe, la H mantuvo el orden y al minuto 21 estuvo muy cerca de abrir el marcador. El capitán Jeffrey Ramos se incorporó al ataque y sacó un potente disparo desde fuera del área que pasó apenas desviado, arrancando el grito de gol de los aficionados hondureños presentes en el estadio. La fortuna siguió dándole la espalda al conjunto nacional. Apenas un minuto después, al 22, Honduras volvió a verse obligada a modificar su esquema debido a otra lesión. Yeremy David abandonó el terreno de juego y fue reemplazado por Kesdy Sevilla. Hasta ese momento Honduras competía de igual a igual, pero todo cambió de manera radical en la recta final del primer tiempo. Al minuto 34 comenzó la debacle. Panamá ejecutó un tiro de esquina que encontró completamente solo a Josué Wood dentro del área. El delantero conectó de cabeza y aprovechó una pésima salida del guardameta hondureño para enviar la pelota al fondo de la red y establecer el 1-0. Fue un golpe del que la Bicolor nunca logró recuperarse. El tanto afectó anímicamente a los catrachos, que perdieron el orden y comenzaron a cometer errores defensivos. Panamá olió sangre y no perdonó. Al minuto 42 llegó el segundo golpe. Moisés Richards mostró toda su calidad al definir con un elegante globito sobre el arquero hondureño. El balón se estrelló en el poste, pero el propio atacante estuvo atento al rebote para empujar la pelota al fondo de las redes y aumentar la ventaja canalera, aprovechando nuevamente las desatenciones de la defensa hondureña. Cuando parecía que el descanso llegaría para intentar reorganizar al equipo, apareció el golpe que prácticamente sentenció la historia. En el tiempo agregado del primer tiempo, al minuto 49, Gerson Gordon recibió dentro del área y sacó un potente bombazo imposible de detener para el arquero hondureño. El 3-0 dejó a la Bicolor completamente contra las cuerdas antes del descanso. La segunda mitad fue un trámite. Honduras intentó reaccionar con más orgullo que fútbol, pero nunca encontró respuestas frente a un Panamá sólido, ordenado y muy superior en todas las líneas. Los canaleros administraron la ventaja con tranquilidad y terminaron de liquidar el compromiso al minuto 69. Tras un rebote concedido por el guardameta hondureño, Carlos Rodríguez apareció sin oposición para empujar el balón y decretar el definitivo 4-0. El resto del partido transcurrió entre la resignación de Honduras y la celebración panameña. La Bicolor nunca encontró el camino para descontar, mientras Panamá manejó el balón hasta escuchar el silbatazo final que confirmó su clasificación a los cuartos de final. Para Honduras, en cambio, fue el cierre de un torneo para el olvido. La ilusión de volver a una Copa del Mundo Sub-20 se apagó de manera contundente y el sueño olímpico también quedó sepultado. Una nueva generación se despide sin cumplir los objetivos y el fútbol hondureño vuelve a enfrentar una profunda reflexión sobre el rumbo de sus procesos juveniles tras otro fracaso internacional. data.translatedTitle: Honduras, humiliated: goodbye to the U-20 World Cup and the Olympic Games
data.translatedDescription: The Honduras U-20 National Team had one of the most painful nights in recent years and consummated a new international failure by falling resoundingly 4-0 against Panama, a result that left it eliminated from the Concacaf World Cup and, with it, without the possibility of qualifying for the next U-20 World Cup or the 2028 Los Angeles Olympic Games. The Bicolor arrived at the BUAP University Stadium in Puebla, Mexico, with the hope intact and depending on itself to advance to the quarterfinals of the competition. The outlook was clear: winning meant staying alive and keeping the World Cup dream burning. However, the reality was completely different. Honduras was surpassed with authority by a Panamanian team that took advantage of every mistake, struck at key moments and ended up humiliating a rival that completely collapsed. The final whistle left images of sadness, helplessness and frustration among the Honduran soccer players, aware that they let a historic opportunity slip away. Panama, on the other hand, justly celebrated a victory that placed it in the next round of the championship. With this elimination, Honduras is once again left out of a U-20 World Cup and also loses the possibility of fighting for one of the tickets to the next Olympic Games, deepening the crisis that the country's minor teams are going through. The defeat also puts coach Orlando López at the center of criticism, who once again could not meet his objectives at the head of a Honduran youth team. The strategist closes another process marked by disappointment and questions, while Catracho football adds a new chapter of frustration in the training categories. The match began with a brave Honduras, which tried to impose conditions from the first minutes. Just in the 3rd minute, Mike Arana starred in a great individual play on the wing, sending a dangerous cross, but the Panamanian defense reacted in time to clear the ball before a Honduran attacker arrived. The Bicolor continued to insist and at minute 7 they created danger again. Once again Arana overflowed the side and placed a precise cross into the heart of the area, where David Flores arrived with the intention of finishing, although he failed to connect the ball when it seemed that the scoring was opening. When Honduras showed signs of controlling the commitment, the bad news began to arrive. At minute 12, Arbin Medrano suffered an injury that prevented him from continuing in the match and forced the coaching staff to make the first modification of the match. Nicolás Balbas took his place. Despite the blow, the H maintained order and in the 21st minute came very close to opening the scoring. Captain Jeffrey Ramos joined the attack and took a powerful shot from outside the area that went just wide, eliciting a shout of goal from the Honduran fans present in the stadium. Fortune continued to turn its back on the national team. Just one minute later, at 22, Honduras was once again forced to modify its scheme due to another injury. Yeremy David left the field of play and was replaced by Kesdy Sevilla. Until that moment, Honduras competed as equals, but everything changed radically in the final stretch of the first half. At minute 34 the debacle began. Panama executed a corner kick that found Josué Wood completely alone inside the area. The forward connected with a header and took advantage of a poor start by the Honduran goalkeeper to send the ball into the back of the net and establish the 1-0 score. It was a blow from which the Bicolor never managed to recover. The goal affected the Catrachos emotionally, who lost order and began to make defensive errors. Panama smelled blood and did not forgive. At minute 42 came the second blow. Moisés Richards showed all his quality by defining with an elegant lob over the Honduran goalkeeper. The ball hit the post, but the attacker himself was attentive to the rebound to push the ball into the back of the net and increase the channel's advantage, again taking advantage of the inattention of the Honduran defense. When it seemed that the break would come to try to reorganize the team, the blow appeared that practically sealed history. In added time of the first half, at minute 49, Gerson Gordon received inside the area and took a powerful shot that was impossible for the Honduran goalkeeper to stop. The 3-0 score left Bicolor completely on the ropes before the break. The second half was a formality. Honduras tried to react with more pride than football, but never found answers against a solid, orderly and far superior Panama in all lines. The Canaleros managed the advantage calmly and finished the match in the 69th minute. After a rebound conceded by the Honduran goalkeeper, Carlos Rodríguez appeared unopposed to push the ball and declare the final 4-0. The rest of the game passed between the resignation of Honduras and the Panamanian celebration. The Bicolor never found a way to score, while Panama handled the ball until hearing the final whistle that confirmed its classification to the quarterfinals. For Honduras, on the other hand, it was the closing of a tournament to be forgotten. The hope of returning to a U-20 World Cup was extinguished decisively and the Olympic dream was also buried. A new generation says goodbye without meeting its objectives and Honduran soccer once again faces a deep reflection on the direction of its youth processes after another international failure. Both Honduras and Panama will advance to the quarterfinals if they achieve victory, either as one of the two best third parties in the tournament. This will be the fifth confrontation between Honduras and Panama in the Concacaf U-20 Championship, a series in which the Catrachos dominate with three wins and one draw. The most recent precedent favors the Hondurans, who in the quarterfinals of the 2022 edition defeated the Panamanians 2-1 to advance and leave their rival on the road. With qualification at stake and the World Cup dream in its sights, Honduras will face one of the most demanding tests of the tournament. data.title: Subirán los combustibles en Honduras: Estos serán los precios de la gasolina y el diésel
data.description: Los hondureños volverán a enfrentar un incremento en el precio de los combustibles a partir del lunes 3 de agosto de 2026 , luego de que la Secretaría de Energí a (SEN) anunciara una nueva estructura de precios que contempla alzas en casi todos los derivados del petróleo, mientras que el GLP doméstico mantendrá su valor gracias al subsidio del Gobierno . La gasolina superior y regular, el diésel, el kerosene y el GLP vehicular sufrirán aumentos tanto en Tegucigalpa como en San Pedro Sula, siendo el kerosene y el diésel los carburantes con los mayores ajustes para la próxima semana. En Tegucigalpa, la gasolina superior aumentará L3.25, por lo que pasará a costar L138.41 por galón. La gasolina regular subirá L2.34, alcanzando un precio de L126.07, mientras que el diésel incrementará L5.19 y se venderá a L129.45. El kerosene también reflejará una fuerte alza de L6.27, elevando su precio hasta L115.66 por galón. En tanto, el GLP doméstico permanecerá en L249.62 gracias al subsidio gubernamental de L35.22, y el GLP vehicular aumentará 31 centavos, fijándose en L48.27. Para San Pedro Sula, la gasolina superior registrará un incremento de L3.00, con un nuevo precio de L134.83 por galón. La gasolina regular subirá L2.20, situándose en L122.65, mientras que el diésel aumentará L5.04 y costará L125.99. El kerosene también experimentará una de las mayores alzas en la capital industrial, con un incremento de L6.01, por lo que el galón se venderá a L112.06. El GLP doméstico seguirá costando L228.47, respaldado por un subsidio de L35.58, y el GLP vehicular pasará a L44.74, tras un aumento de 31 centavos. Con este nuevo ajuste, los consumidores deberán destinar un mayor presupuesto para el transporte y otras actividades que dependen del uso de combustibles, especialmente quienes utilizan diésel o kerosene, productos que registran los mayores incrementos de la semana. La nueva estructura de precios entrará en vigor desde las 6:00 de la mañana del lunes 3 de agosto de 2026 en todas las estaciones de servicio del país.
data.translatedTitle: Fuel prices will rise in Honduras: These will be the prices of gasoline and diesel
data.translatedDescription: Hondurans will once again face an increase in fuel prices starting Monday, August 3, 2026, after the Energy Secretariat (SEN) announced a new price structure that includes increases in almost all petroleum derivatives, while domestic LPG will maintain its value thanks to the Government subsidy. Premium and regular gasoline, diesel, kerosene and vehicular LPG will suffer increases in both Tegucigalpa and San Pedro Sula, with kerosene and diesel being the fuels with the greatest adjustments for next week. In Tegucigalpa, premium gasoline will increase by L3.25, so it will cost L138.41 per gallon. Regular gasoline will increase by L2.34, reaching a price of L126.07, while diesel will increase by L5.19 and will be sold at L129.45. Kerosene will also reflect a sharp increase of L6.27, raising its price to L115.66 per gallon. Meanwhile, domestic LPG will remain at L249.62 thanks to the government subsidy of L35.22, and vehicular LPG will increase 31 cents, settling at L48.27. For San Pedro Sula, premium gasoline will register an increase of L3.00, with a new price of L134.83 per gallon. Regular gasoline will increase by L2.20, reaching L122.65, while diesel will increase by L5.04 and cost L125.99. Kerosene will also experience one of the largest increases in the industrial capital, with an increase of L6.01, so a gallon will be sold at L112.06. Domestic LPG will continue to cost L228.47, supported by a subsidy of L35.58, and vehicular LPG will go to L44.74, after an increase of 31 cents. With this new adjustment, consumers will have to allocate a larger budget for transportation and other activities that depend on the use of fuel, especially those who use diesel or kerosene, products that register the largest increases of the week. The new pricing structure will come into effect from 6:00 in the morning on Monday, August 3, 2026 at all service stations in the country.

data.title: Capturan a "Juan, el Malón", supuesto líder criminal del Merendón
data.description: Dos presuntos integrantes de una estructura criminal señalada de operar en la zona de reserva del Merendón fueron capturados por la Policía Nacional durante un operativo ejecutado en el barrio Lempira, San Pedro Sula. Los detenidos, de 45 y 21 años, son residentes de la aldea Las Peñitas y estarían vinculados a la estructura dirigida por alias "Juan el Malón" , señalado por las autoridades como uno de los principales generadores de violencia en el sector del Merendón. Según las investigaciones, a los aprehendidos se les atribuye la presunta participación en delitos de homicidio, asesinato en su grado de ejecución de tentativa en perjuicio de Carlos Alberto Arriaga y un testigo protegido. Además, se les relaciona con supuestos casos de desplazamiento forzoso y delitos ambientales. La Policía Nacional informó que durante las operaciones realizadas contra esta estructura criminal en la zona se decomisaron tres motosierras, equipo con características militares, botas tácticas, cámaras de vigilancia, un vehículo y una cantidad no especificada de madera, objetos que presuntamente eran utilizados para sus actividades ilícitas. Las autoridades indicaron que la captura forma parte de una estrategia orientada a intervenir sectores afectados por amenazas, violencia y despojo de tierras, con el objetivo de recuperar la seguridad en las comunidades del área. Los sospechosos serán puestos a disposición de los tribunales correspondientes para continuar con el proceso judicial establecido en la ley, mientras la Policía Nacional mantiene las investigaciones para ubicar a otros posibles integrantes de la estructura criminal.
data.translatedTitle: They capture "Juan, el Malón", alleged criminal leader of Merendón
data.translatedDescription: Two alleged members of a criminal structure accused of operating in the Merendón reserve area were captured by the National Police during an operation carried out in the Lempira neighborhood, San Pedro Sula. The detainees, aged 45 and 21, are residents of the village Las Peñitas and would be linked to the structure led by alias "Juan el Malón", identified by the authorities as one of the main generators of violence in the Merendón sector. According to the investigations, those arrested are attributed with alleged participation in crimes of homicide, attempted murder to the detriment of Carlos Alberto Arriaga and a protected witness. In addition, they are related to alleged cases of forced displacement and environmental crimes. The National Police reported that during the operations carried out against this criminal structure in the area, three chainsaws, equipment with military characteristics, tactical boots, surveillance cameras, a vehicle and an unspecified amount of wood were seized, objects that were allegedly used for their illicit activities. The authorities indicated that the capture is part of a strategy aimed at intervening in sectors affected by threats, violence and land dispossession, with the aim of recovering security in the communities of the area. The suspects will be placed at the disposal of the corresponding courts to continue with the judicial process established by law, while the National Police maintains investigations to locate other possible members of the criminal structure.
