It is also recommended to charge cell phones, laptops, and any other electronic devices you may need in advance during the duration of the service interruption.

data.title: Escasas lluvias en Lepaterique mantienen a Los Laureles con apenas 32% de agua
data.description: Tegucigalpa, Honduras.- La crisis de abastecimiento de agua en Tegucigalpa se intensifica mientras la represa Los Laureles mantiene un nivel 32% de almacenamiento y las comunidades ubicadas en la zona alta de Lepaterique reportan una disminución de las l luvias que alimentan la subcuenca del río Guacerique. Durante los últimos tres días, el embalse Los Laureles ha permanecido con un nivel cercano al 32.37%, una condición que refleja la reducción de los aportes de agua provenientes de las corrientes superficiales y escorrentías que llegan desde la zona productora. La falta de precipitaciones en comunidades como Yerbabuena y otros sectores montañosos de Lepaterique ha reducido el caudal de las pequeñas corrientes que alimentan el río Guacerique, limitando la recuperación de las reservas del embalse. Habitantes de estas comunidades reportan que las lluvias han sido escasas durante estos meses del presente año, afectando la generación natural de agua que baja desde las zonas altas hacia la fuente que abastece a parte del Distrito Central. La subcuenca del río Guacerique es considerada estratégica para Tegucigalpa debido a que aporta una parte importante del recurso hídrico que consume la capital y mantiene una relación directa con el comportamiento de la represa Los Laureles. Según el Consejo de la Subcuenca del Río Guacerique, esta zona fue declarada mediante el acuerdo No. 03-73 del 2 de enero de 1973 como “Zona Forestal Protegida del Patrimonio Público Forestal Inalienable”. El área protegida cuenta con una extensión de 210.63 kilómetros cuadrados y se ubica al oeste de Tegucigalpa, dentro de los municipios del Distrito Central y Lepaterique. Esta subcuenca cubre aproximadamente el 25% de la demanda de agua de la capital , por lo que la disminución de sus aportes representa un riesgo para el sistema de abastecimiento durante los próximos meses. Mientras Los Laureles permanece con niveles bajos, la r epresa La Concepción registra un almacenamiento de 40.25 por ciento de su capacidad, de acuerdo con los reportes de la Unidad Municipal de Agua Potable y Saneamiento (UMAPS). Los niveles actuales de ambos embalses mantienen bajo vigilancia el sistema hídrico del Distrito Central, donde la disminución de las lluvias y el crecimiento de la demanda aumentan la presión sobre las fuentes de abastecimiento. Especialistas ambientales han señalado que la protección de las zonas productoras de agua es fundamental para garantizar la disponibilidad del recurso, especialmente durante períodos prolongados con pocas precipitaciones. Los bajos niveles de Los Laureles obligan a mantener un monitoreo constante de las reservas disponibles y del comportamiento de las fuentes que abastecen a Tegucigalpa y Comayagüela.
data.translatedTitle: Little rain in Lepaterique keeps Los Laureles with barely 32% water
data.translatedDescription: Tegucigalpa, Honduras.- The water supply crisis in Tegucigalpa intensifies while the Los Laureles dam maintains a 32% storage level and the communities located in the upper area of ​​Lepaterique report a decrease in rainfall that feeds the sub-basin of the Guacerique River. During the last three days, the Los Laureles reservoir has remained at a level close to 32.37%, a condition that reflects the reduction in water contributions from surface currents and runoff that arrive from the producing area. The lack of precipitation in communities such as Yerbabuena and other mountainous sectors of Lepaterique has reduced the flow of the small streams that feed the Guacerique River, limiting the recovery of the reservoir's reserves. Inhabitants of these communities report that rains have been scarce during these months of this year, affecting the natural generation of water that comes down from the high areas to the source that supplies part of the Central District. The Guacerique River sub-basin is considered strategic for Tegucigalpa because it provides an important part of the water resource consumed by the capital and maintains a direct relationship with the behavior of the Los Laureles dam. According to the Guacerique River Subbasin Council, this area was declared by agreement No. 03-73 of January 2, 1973 as a “Protected Forest Area of ​​the Inalienable Forest Public Heritage.” The protected area has an area of ​​210.63 square kilometers and is located west of Tegucigalpa, within the municipalities of the Central District and Lepaterique. This sub-basin covers approximately 25% of the capital's water demand, so the decrease in its contributions represents a risk for the supply system during the coming months. While Los Laureles remains at low levels, the La Concepción dam registers a storage of 40.25 percent of its capacity, according to reports from the Municipal Drinking Water and Sanitation Unit (UMAPS). The current levels of both reservoirs keep the Central District's water system under surveillance, where the decrease in rainfall and the growth in demand increase pressure on supply sources. Environmental specialists have pointed out that the protection of water-producing areas is essential to guarantee the availability of the resource, especially during prolonged periods with little rainfall. The low levels of Los Laureles require constant monitoring of available reserves and the behavior of the sources that supply Tegucigalpa and Comayagüela.

data.title: Aumentos en los precios de los combustibles a partir del lunes 3 de agosto: alzas de hasta L3 y L6 ​​​​​​

data.title: Alcaldía propone que Toncontín tenga vuelos a San Salvador, Guatemala, Panamá y Costa Rica
data.description: Tegucigalpa, Honduras.- La Alcaldía Municipal del Distrito Central propuso que el aeropuerto Toncontín opere vuelos regionales hacia destinos de Centroamérica como una medida para fortalecer la competitividad de Tegucigalpa y facilitar la conectividad de la capital. Juan Diego Zelaya, alcalde de la ciudad, señaló que la distancia entre la ciudad y el aeropuerto internacional de Palmerola, Comayagua, representa una desventaja para atraer inversiones, congresos y eventos, por lo que considera necesario analizar soluciones de movilidad y conectividad. “Lo que quiero es que la ciudad sea competitiva y, obviamente, con un aeropuerto que nos queda entre hora y media y dos horas de distancia, es difícil. No competimos para atraer eventos ni para muchas otras oportunidades”, expresó Zelaya. Indicó que actualmente existen dos alternativas que podrían mejorar el acceso aéreo para los capitalinos, aunque reconoció que una de ellas requiere una inversión considerable. “Aquí hay dos opciones. Una es construir una vía alterna, como lo hizo Medellín, donde construyeron un túnel para que las personas que llegan al aeropuerto de Río Negro puedan trasladarse más rápido a la ciudad”, manifestó a EL HERALDO. El alcalde recordó que esa infraestructura permitió reducir significativamente el tiempo de viaje entre el aeropuerto y la ciudad colombiana, convirtiéndose en un modelo de referencia para mejorar la conectividad. “Antes el recorrido tomaba dos horas y ahora se realiza en 25 minutos. Sin embargo, esa es una obra muy costosa”, afirmó el jefe edilicio al referirse al ejemplo de Medellín. No obstante, Zelaya considera que existe una alternativa más factible para el corto plazo y que podría implementarse sin desarrollar una obra de gran magnitud. “La otra opción es reclasificar el aeropuerto Toncontín y permitir los vuelos regionales. Es decir, que yo pueda viajar desde Toncontín hacia San Salvador, Guatemala, San José o Panamá. Hoy por hoy no puedo hacerlo”, sostuvo. Explicó que esta medida facilitaría los desplazamientos dentro de Centroamérica y permitiría que Tegucigalpa recupere parte de la conectividad aérea que ha perdido en los últimos años. “Toncontín no opera como un aeropuerto internacional. Lo que se necesita es autorizar que tenga vuelos regionales. Esas son las dos opciones que veo como viables”, indicó. El alcalde considera que contar con conexiones regionales fortalecería la actividad económica, impulsaría el turismo de negocios y mejoraría las condiciones para atraer inversiones a la capital. Toncontín dejó de operar vuelos internacionales el 15 de diciembre de 2021, cuando esas operaciones fueron trasladadas al Aeropuerto Internacional de Palmerola, en Comayagua. Desde entonces, la terminal capitalina quedó destinada a vuelos nacionales, aviación privada y otras operaciones aeronáuticas. La decisión respondió a la puesta en funcionamiento de Palmerola como el principal aeropuerto internacional de la zona central del país. El último vuelo internacional que despegó de Toncontín fue operado por American Airlines con destino a Dallas, Texas, marcando el cierre de una etapa de más de ocho décadas de operaciones internacionales desde Tegucigalpa. Desde 2022, sectores empresariales, turísticos y autoridades de la capital han manifestado en diferentes ocasiones la necesidad de recuperar parte de la conectividad internacional de Toncontín, argumentando que la distancia entre Tegucigalpa y Palmerola representa un reto para la movilidad de pasajeros y el desarrollo económico de la ciudad. No obstante, en mayo de 2026, la Secretaría de Infraestructura y Transporte (SIT) reiteró que el contrato de concesión de Palmerola impide que Toncontín vuelva a operar como aeropuerto internacional, debido a una cláusula que restringe la habilitación de otra terminal con ese tipo de operaciones dentro de un radio de 100 kilómetros.
data.translatedTitle: Mayor's Office proposes that Toncontín have flights to San Salvador, Guatemala, Panama and Costa Rica
data.translatedDescription: Tegucigalpa, Honduras.- The Municipal Mayor's Office of the Central District proposed that the Toncontín airport operate regional flights to Central American destinations as a measure to strengthen the competitiveness of Tegucigalpa and facilitate the connectivity of the capital. Juan Diego Zelaya, mayor of the city, pointed out that the distance between the city and the international airport of Palmerola, Comayagua, represents a disadvantage in attracting investments, conferences and events, which is why he considers it necessary to analyze mobility and connectivity solutions. "What I want is for the city to be competitive and, obviously, with an airport that is between an hour and a half and two hours away, it is difficult. We do not compete to attract events or for many other opportunities," said Zelaya. He indicated that there are currently two alternatives that could improve air access for the capital's residents, although he acknowledged that one of them requires a considerable investment. "Here there are two options. One is to build an alternate route, like Medellín did, where they built a tunnel so that people arriving at the Río Negro airport can travel to the city faster," he told EL HERALDO. The mayor recalled that this infrastructure made it possible to significantly reduce travel time between the airport and the Colombian city, becoming a reference model to improve connectivity. "Before, the journey took two hours and now it takes 25 minutes. However, this is a very expensive project," said the building chief, referring to the example of Medellín. However, Zelaya considers that there is a more feasible alternative for the short term and that it could be implemented without developing a large-scale project. "The other option is to reclassify the Toncontín airport and allow regional flights. That is, I can travel from Toncontín to San Salvador, Guatemala, San José or Panama. Today I cannot do so," he said. He explained that this measure would facilitate travel within Central America and would allow Tegucigalpa to recover part of the air connectivity that it has lost in recent years. "Toncontín does not operate as an international airport. What is needed is to authorize it to have regional flights. Those are the two options that I see as viable," he indicated. The mayor believes that having regional connections would strengthen economic activity, boost business tourism and improve the conditions to attract investments to the capital. Toncontín stopped operating international flights on December 15, 2021, when those operations were transferred to Palmerola International Airport, in Comayagua. Since then, the capital terminal was used for domestic flights, private aviation and other aeronautical operations. The decision responded to the start-up of Palmerola as the main international airport in the central area of ​​the country. The last international flight that took off from Toncontín was operated by American Airlines bound for Dallas, Texas, marking the closing of a stage of more than eight decades of international operations from Tegucigalpa. Since 2022, business and tourism sectors and authorities of the capital have expressed on different occasions the need to recover part of the international connectivity of Toncontín, arguing that the distance between Tegucigalpa and Palmerola represents a challenge for passenger mobility and the economic development of the city. However, in May 2026, the Ministry of Infrastructure and Transportation (SIT) reiterated that the Palmerola concession contract prevents Toncontín from operating as an international airport again, due to a clause that restricts the authorization of another terminal with this type of operations within a 100-kilometer radius.

data.title: Capturan en Michigan a hondureño acusado por asesinato; fue deportado dos veces
data.description: Michigan, Estados Unidos.- Un migrante hondureño acusado por asesinato fue arrestado por agentes de la Patrulla Fronteriza en el estado de Michigan, Estados Unidos. El centroamericano fue identificado como Michael Jamblyck Costly Bennett, de 30 años de edad. Su arresto se efectuó el pasado 30 de julio en un operativo de control vial en la ciudad de Taylor. En el momento de su arresto, los agentes descubrieron que Costly Bennett portaba documentación falsa, tales como tarjetas de seguridad social y de residencia permanente. El comunicado emitido por la Fiscalía del Distrito Este de Michigan señala que el hondureño es buscado por asesinato en el extranjero. No obstante, no especifica el país donde presuntamente se cometió el delito. Por otro lado, la Fiscalía detalló que Costly Bennett ya había sido deportado de Estados Unidos en dos ocasiones. Costly Bennett compareció ante un tribunal federal de Detroit y se mantiene bajo custodia a la espera de su proceso judicial. El pasado 27 de julio fue arrestado el hondureño Darwin Cárcamo Santiago (24 años), investigado de haber matado a su novia en Maryland, informó Fox News 45. Cárcamo es imputado por asesinato en primer y segundo grado en perjuicio de Esmeralda Pérez Méndez, de 35 años. La policía arribó el 26 de julio a la residencia de Pérez Méndez, luego de que un conocido de Cárcamo la encontrara sin vida. De acuerdo a la policía, la víctima presentaba lesiones de estrangulamiento y los detectives apuntan a que el crimen se cometió entre el sábado 25 y domingo 26.
data.translatedTitle: Honduran accused of murder captured in Michigan; he was deported twice

The Central American was identified as Michael Jamblyck Costly Bennett, 30 years old. His arrest took place on July 30 during a road control operation in the city of Taylor. At the time of his arrest, officers discovered that Costly Bennett was carrying false documentation, such as social security and permanent residence cards. The statement issued by the Prosecutor's Office for the Eastern District of Michigan indicates that the Honduran is wanted for murder abroad. However, it does not specify the country where the crime was allegedly committed. On the other hand, the Prosecutor's Office detailed that Costly Bennett had already been deported from the United States on two occasions. Costly Bennett appeared in federal court in Detroit and remains in custody pending his trial. On July 27, Honduran Darwin Cárcamo Santiago (24 years old) was arrested, investigated for having killed his girlfriend in Maryland, reported Fox News 45. Cárcamo is charged with first and second degree murder to the detriment of Esmeralda Pérez Méndez, 35 years old. The police arrived at Pérez Méndez's residence on July 26, after an acquaintance of Cárcamo found her dead. According to the police, the victim had strangulation injuries and detectives suggest that the crime was committed between Saturday the 25th and Sunday the 26th.

data.title: Ferran Torres-PSG, destinados a unir sus caminos en este mercado de fichajes
data.description: Barcelona, España.- Hace dos semanas, Ferran Torres marcó el gol que le dio a España el título del Mundial 2026 , una actuación que despertó el interés del PSG , quienes están dispuestos a apostar todo por él y ya preparan los primeros contactos con el FC Barcelona para negociar su traspaso. De acuerdo con Matteo Moretto , periodista especializado en el mercado de fichajes, las condiciones económicas entre el PSG y Ferran Torres estarían resueltas, por lo que el futuro de la operación dependerá de las conversaciones entre ambos clubes. A Ferran Torres le queda un año de contrato y el Barcelona lleva meses sin dar señales de vida para negociar la renovación del atacante valenciano, abriéndole la puerta de salida para facilitar la llegada de Julián Álvarez . Fabrizio Romano coincide con la información de Matteo Moretto y señaló, mediante una publicación en su cuenta oficial de Instagram , que Ferran Torres es uno de los candidatos a reforzar el ataque del PSG en este mercado. "¡Última hora! El PSG está en conversaciones con el entorno de Ferran Torres, una decisión que depende del futbolista. El Barcelona solo lo venderá si el delantero pide públicamente dejar el club". "PSG no solo cerró el acuerdo de Akliouche (extremo del AS Mónaco) y Mika Godts (delantero del Ajax) está en marcha, también se mantiene en contacto con Ferran Torres para un posible traspaso". "Los parisinos quieren tres fichajes en la delantera, ya que Gonçalo Ramos, Kang-in Lee y Mbaye saldrán del equipo", explicó Fabrizio Romano en una publicación que superó los 500,000 likes en menos de tres horas. Ante este escenario, Ferran Torres tiene dos opciones sobre la mesa: renovar con el FC Barcelona o aceptar la propuesta del PSG, vigentes bicampeones de la UEFA Champions League.
data.translatedTitle: Ferran Torres-PSG, destined to join their paths in this transfer market
data.translatedDescription: Barcelona, ​​Spain.- Two weeks ago, Ferran Torres scored the goal that gave Spain the 2026 World Cup title, a performance that aroused the interest of PSG, who are willing to bet everything on him and are already preparing the first contacts with FC Barcelona to negotiate his transfer. According to Matteo Moretto, a journalist specialized in the transfer market, the economic conditions between PSG and Ferran Torres would be resolved, so the future of the operation will depend on the conversations between both clubs. Ferran Torres has one year left on his contract and Barcelona has been showing no signs of life for months to negotiate the renewal of the Valencian attacker, opening the exit door for him to facilitate the arrival of Julián Álvarez. Fabrizio Romano agrees with Matteo Moretto's information and pointed out, through a publication on his official Instagram account, that Ferran Torres is one of the candidates to reinforce PSG's attack in this market. "Breaking news! PSG is in talks with Ferran Torres' entourage, a decision that depends on the player. Barcelona will only sell him if the forward publicly asks to leave the club." "PSG not only closed the deal for Akliouche (AS Monaco winger) and Mika Godts (Ajax striker) is underway, they are also in contact with Ferran Torres for a possible transfer." "The Parisians want three signings up front, since Gonçalo Ramos, Kang-in Lee and Mbaye will leave the team," explained Fabrizio Romano in a publication that surpassed 500,000 likes in less than three hours. Given this scenario, Ferran Torres has two options on the table: renew with FC Barcelona or accept the proposal from PSG, current two-time UEFA Champions League champions.

data.title: CSJ reporta más de 15 mil expedientes activos en juzgados laborales
data.description: Tegucigalpa, Honduras.- Los Juzgados de Letras del Trabajo de Francisco Morazán mantienen una carga de alrededor de 15 mil expedientes activos , un volumen que refleja la saturación de esa jurisdicción y prolonga los tiempos de tramitación y resolución de los procesos laborales, informó la Corte Suprema de Justicia (CSJ). La magistrada Anny Ochoa informó que la carga procesal representa un promedio cercano a 1,000 casos por cada juez, situación que ha incrementado los tiempos de espera para el desarrollo de audiencias y la emisión de resoluciones. "En este juzgado se están manejando alrededor de 15 mil expedientes. Esto evidencia una saturación importante y esperamos implementar un plan de contingencia que permita reducir los tiempos para el señalamiento de audiencias", explicó. La funcionaria reconoció que la mora judicial continúa siendo una de las principales preocupaciones del pleno de la Corte Suprema de Justicia, por lo que actualmente se ejecuta una estrategia para agilizar la respuesta de los juzgados laborales. “Existe preocupación por la mora, por lo que estamos desarrollando un plan de trabajo orientado a reducir el atraso en estos juzgados y tribunales", manifestó. Ochoa señaló que la elevada cantidad de expedientes provoca constantes reclamos por parte de los profesionales del derecho debido a la demora en la tramitación y resolución de los procesos laborales. No obstante, la magistrada explicó que el pleno de la CSJ también permanece a la espera de informes judiciales que permitan verificar el cumplimiento de las metas establecidas dentro del plan para disminuir el atraso en esta jurisdicción. Explicó que el órgano de justicia prevé que durante la primera quincena de agosto se notifiquen más de 100 sentencias en los Juzgados de Letras del Trabajo de Francisco Morazán. La proyección parte de que los 10 jueces asignados a esta jurisdicción emitan al menos 10 resoluciones individuales cada uno en los próximos días. "Esperamos que los jueces puedan hacer la notificación de al menos diez sentencias cada uno. Al contar con diez jueces, estimamos que saldrán más de 100 sentencias en la primera quincena del mes de agosto", afirmó la funcionaria. Con esa meta, la Corte Suprema buscará reducir de manera gradual la mora judicial y avanzar en la atención de los miles de expedientes que permanecen activos en los juzgados laborales de Francisco Morazán.
data.translatedTitle: CSJ reports more than 15 thousand active files in labor courts
data.translatedDescription: Tegucigalpa, Honduras.- The Labor Courts of Francisco Morazán maintain a load of around 15 thousand active files, a volume that reflects the saturation of that jurisdiction and prolongs the processing and resolution times of labor processes, reported the Supreme Court of Justice (CSJ). Judge Anny Ochoa reported that the procedural load represents an average of close to 1,000 cases for each judge, a situation that has increased waiting times for the development of hearings and the issuance of resolutions. "In this court, around 15 thousand files are being handled. This shows a significant saturation and we hope to implement a contingency plan that will reduce the time for scheduling hearings," he explained. The official recognized that judicial delay continues to be one of the main concerns of the plenary session of the Supreme Court of Justice, which is why a strategy is currently being executed to speed up the response of the labor courts. "There is concern about the delay, so we are developing a work plan aimed at reducing the delay in these courts and tribunals," he said. Ochoa pointed out that the high number of files causes constant complaints from legal professionals due to the delay in the processing and resolution of labor processes. However, the magistrate explained that the plenary session of the CSJ is also awaiting judicial reports that will allow verification of compliance with the goals established within the plan to reduce the delay in this jurisdiction. He explained that the justice body expects that during the first fortnight of August more than 100 sentences will be notified in the Labor Courts of Francisco Morazán. The projection is that the 10 judges assigned to this jurisdiction will issue at least 10 individual resolutions each in the coming days. "We hope that the judges can notify at least ten sentences each. By having ten judges, we estimate that more than 100 sentences will be issued in the first half of August," said the official. With this goal, the Supreme Court will seek to gradually reduce the judicial delay and advance in the attention of the thousands of files that remain active in the labor courts of Francisco Morazán.

data.title: "Sos una mala madre, hija de put*": Video de mujer insultando y agrediendo a su mamá en El Paraíso
data.description: El Paraíso, Honduras.- Una mujer de 37 años fue captada en un video mientras insultaba y posteriormente agredía a su madre en el barrio El Campo, municipio de Teupasenti, departamento de El Paraíso. Preliminarmente, se conoció que la mujer fue identificada como Tira Maryori Borjas Ortiz, mientras que la madre responde al nombre de Zonia Esperanza Ortiz García. El video muestra el momento en que la madre se encuentra sentada en un sofá, mientras su hija permanece de pie frente a ella lanzándole insultos. "Sos una mala madre, hija de put*, cerot*", se escucha decir a la mujer mientras se dirige a su madre. La madre le respondió: "Mejor cállate", pero su hija continúa con los insultos y vuelve a decirle: "Cállate, hija de put*". En la grabación también se escucha la voz de un hombre, quien presuntamente sería otro hijo de la señora, diciendo: "Dele con la faja, usted es la nana". En los últimos segundos del video se observa que la madre se levanta del sillón y su hija se coloca frente a ella. Posteriormente, la mujer de 37 años la empuja y luego se retira del lugar. Las autoridades de la Dirección Policial de Investigaciones (DPI) informaron que ya realizaron la captura de la mujer señalada  del delito de maltrato familiar agravado.

data.title: JOH cuestiona al juez que se declaró incompetente para seguir con su caso
data.description: Tegucigalpa, Honduras.- El expresidente de Honduras Juan Orlando Hernández (2014-2022) cuestionó el viernes que el juez natural designado para conocer su causa, por presunto fraude y lavado de activos, se declarara incompetente para continuar con el proceso, abierto en 2023, y volvió a denunciar una supuesta “persecución política”. "Ahora me encuentro que el juez natural que me citó para comparecer a la audiencia inicial el 3 de agosto abruptamente cambió de opinión. ¿Qué lo habrá hecho cambiar de opinión?", expresó Hernández en sus redes sociales. El exgobernante señaló que "no quisiera creer" que la decisión forme parte "de la misma persecución política" que, según él, ha denunciado desde que fue requerido por la justicia hondureña. El juez natural designado inicialmente para conocer el caso contra Hernández declinó el jueves continuar al frente del proceso al considerar que la investigación no involucra actualmente a un alto funcionario del Estado que justifique la competencia de la Corte Suprema de Justicia (CSJ). La Constitución de Honduras establece que la Corte Suprema conocerá de los procesos incoados a los más altos funcionarios del Estado y a los diputados, cargo que ostentaba Hernández cuando tuvieron lugar los hechos investigados en el caso en su contra. La defensa del exmandatario presentó el viernes un recurso de reposición contra esa decisión, con el que busca que el expediente no sea remitido al Juzgado en Materia de Criminalidad Organizada, Medioambiente y Corrupción, sino que continúe bajo conocimiento de la CSJ. El portavoz del Poder Judicial, Carlos Silva, dijo a periodistas que ahora el juez natural deberá resolver si mantiene su decisión de declinatoria y, de confirmarla, deberá remitir el expediente al órgano jurisdiccional competente en materia de Criminalidad Organizada y Corrupción. Hernández además aseguró que está dispuesto a enfrentar el proceso en Honduras, al igual que lo hizo ante la justicia de Estados Unidos, país que lo juzgó y condenó donde en 2024 a 45 años de prisión por delitos relacionados con narcotráfico, tras ser extraditado en 2022. "Dije desde el segundo día que salí de prisión, así como enfrenté la justicia de Estados Unidos, que voy a enfrentar la justicia hondureña, porque la verdad no la pueden esconder", subrayó. El exmandatario regresó a Honduras el día 26, después de que el 1 de diciembre de 2025 recibiera un indulto total del presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, que dejó sin efecto la condena impuesta en ese país. Aseguró además que durante seis meses solicitó que se levantara la orden de captura emitida en su contra, una petición que fue admitida en junio pasado de manera provisional, y calificó esa medida como parte de una "persecución política". Hernández se presentará de manera voluntaria el próximo 3 de agosto a la audiencia de declaración de imputado por los delitos de fraude y lavado de activos en el caso conocido como 'Pandora II', una investigación que también incluyó al expresidente Porfirio Lobo (2010-2014), favorecido con un sobreseimiento definitivo.
data.translatedTitle: JOH cuestiona al juez que se declaró incompetente para seguir con su caso
data.translatedDescription: Tegucigalpa, Honduras.- The former president of Honduras Juan Orlando Hernández (2014-2022) questioned on Friday that the natural judge appointed to hear his case, for alleged fraud and money laundering, declared himself incompetent to continue with the process, opened in 2023, and again denounced an alleged "political persecution." "Now I find that the natural judge who summoned me to appear at the initial hearing on August 3 abruptly changed his mind. What could have made him change his mind?" Hernández expressed on his social networks. The former governor indicated that "I would not like to believe" that the decision is part of "the same political persecution" that, according to him, he has denounced since he was summoned by the Honduran justice system. The natural judge initially appointed to hear the case against Hernández declined on Thursday to continue leading the process, considering that the investigation does not currently involve a senior State official that justifies the jurisdiction of the Supreme Court of Justice (CSJ). The Constitution of Honduras establishes that the Supreme Court will hear the processes initiated against the highest officials of the State and deputies, a position that Hernández held when the events investigated in the case against him took place. The defense of the former president presented on Friday an appeal for reconsideration against that decision, with which it seeks that the file not be sent to the Court for Organized Crime, Environment and Corruption, but rather that it continue under the knowledge of the CSJ. The spokesman for the Judiciary, Carlos Silva, told journalists that now the natural judge must decide whether to maintain his decision to decline and, if confirmed, he must send the file to the jurisdictional body competent in matters of Organized Crime and Corruption. Hernández also assured that he is willing to face the process in Honduras, just as he did before the justice of the United States, a country that tried and sentenced him in 2024 to 45 years in prison for crimes related to drug trafficking, after being extradited in 2022. "I said from the second day I left prison, just as I faced the justice of the United States, that I am going to face the Honduran justice, because they cannot hide the truth," he stressed. The former president returned to Honduras on the 26th, after receiving a full pardon from the president of the United States, Donald Trump, on December 1, 2025, which annulled the sentence imposed in that country. He also assured that for six months he requested that the arrest warrant issued against him be lifted, a request that was provisionally admitted last June, and described this measure as part of "political persecution." Hernández will appear voluntarily on August 3 at the hearing for the declaration of the accused for the crimes of fraud and money laundering in the case known as 'Pandora II', an investigation that also included former president Porfirio Lobo (2010-2014), favored with a definitive dismissal.

data.title: JAAK VALGE ⟩ Kas juunipunased üritasid korraldada Eestile leebemat saatust?
data.description: Andrei Ždanovi koostatud ja 21. juunil 1940 ametisse nimetatud marionettvalitsusse kuulusid tunnustatud kirjanikud Johannes Vares, Johannes Semper ja ajalooprofessor Hans Kruus. Nende nimed andsid uuele režiimile avalikkuse silmis teatava usaldusväärsuse ning kujundasid vähemalt esialgu mulje, et okupeeritud Eesti tulevik ei pruugi tähendada ilmtingimata liitmist Nõukogude Liiduga, vaid parimal juhul Moskvale alluvat, ent vormiliselt iseseisvat riiki.
data.translatedTitle: JAAK VALGE ⟩ Did the June Reds try to arrange a milder fate for Estonia?
data.translatedDescription: The puppet government prepared by Andrei Zhdanov and appointed on June 21, 1940 included the renowned writers Johannes Vares, Johannes Semper and history professor Hans Kruus. Their names gave the new regime some credibility in the eyes of the public and created, at least initially, the impression that the future of occupied Estonia does not necessarily mean merging with the Soviet Union, but at best a country subordinate to Moscow, but formally independent.

data.title: INTERVJUU ⟩ Hanah Lahe: Mis on radikaalset selles, et naine saab oma keha üle ise otsustada?
data.description: Hanah Lahe on Reformierakonna Riigikogu liige, kes on erakonnas tuntud oma tööga kliima- ja keskkonnapoliitika ning võrdõiguslikkuse teemadel. Ta kuulub Riigikogu keskkonnakomisjoni ja on üks nähtavamaid nooremaid hääli oma erakonnas. Postimees vestles Lahega muu hulgas presidendivalimistest, naiste rollist poliitikas ja ühiskonnas, manosfäärist, kliima- ja keskkonnapoliitikast ning lääne demokraatiate tulevikust.
data.translatedTitle: INTERVIEW ⟩ Hanah Lahe: What is radical about a woman being able to make her own decisions about her body?
data.translatedDescription: Hanah Lahe is a member of the Riigikogu of the Reform Party, who is known in the party for her work on climate and environmental policy and equality. He is a member of the environment committee of the Riigikogu and is one of the most visible younger voices in his party. Postimees talked to Lahe about, among other things, the presidential elections, the role of women in politics and society, the manosphere, climate and environmental policy, and the future of Western democracies.

data.title: Blast at Moscow Restaurant Kills 3 Amid General’s Party
data.description: An explosion at the Balzi Rossi restaurant in central Moscow on Saturday evening killed three people and injured 21 others. The Russian National Antiterrorism Committee stated that a woman attempted to carry an improvised explosive device into the venue but was stopped by a security guard; both died in the blast alongside one patron. The restaurant was hosting a birthday celebration for a Russian general, supported by the presence of military vehicles outside.

data.title: Russian Strikes Hit Kharkiv and Mykolaiv, Injuring 6
data.description: Russian drone strikes targeted Kharkiv and the Mykolaiv region early Sunday morning, injuring at least six people, including three children. In Kharkiv, overnight strikes hit the Industrialnyi, Kyivskyi, and Saltivskyi districts, damaging a high-rise building and causing acute stress reactions in three residents (a 74-year-old man, an eight-year-old girl, and a 13-year-old boy). Mayor Ihor Terekhov noted the use of a “Molniya” loitering munition in the Kyivskyi district.

data.title: Ukrainian Drones Sink Russian Ship Yanina, Hit 3 Ufa Refineries
data.description: Ukrainian drones conducted a massive coordinated operation early Saturday, August 1. Naval drones sank the Rosatom-affiliated container ship Yanina, a sanctioned vessel with a capacity of over 100,000 tons, approximately 130 miles from Novorossiysk. Concurrently, long-range SBU drones struck three major Bashneft oil refineries in Ufa, Bashkortostan, located 1,600 kilometers from the border, with a combined capacity of over 23 million tons annually. Additional strikes targeted three Podlet-K1 and one Kasta-2E2 radar stations in the Krasnodar region, as well as electronic warfare and air defense positions in occupied Crimea.

data.title: Russian ‘Rassvet’ Satellites Secure Two Daily Comms Windows Over Ukraine
data.description: The first batch of 16 Russian “Rassvet” satellites, launched by Bureau 1440 in March 2026, has reached its operational orbit and is currently providing at least two daily “communication windows” over Ukraine, each lasting over an hour. According to satellite communications expert Volodymyr Stepanets, while the satellites pass over Ukraine four times a day, only two or three passes are high enough to ensure stable connections. These windows could theoretically allow Russian forces to control naval drones and long-range UAVs like the Geran series. A second batch of 16 satellites, launched in mid-July, is expected to add two more daily windows by October or November.

data.title: Russian Drone Strike on Rozetka Depot in Brovary Kills 1
data.description: A Russian daytime drone strike hit a logistics center belonging to the e-commerce company Rozetka in Brovary on Aug. 1, killing a 61-year-old man and injuring six others. The attack also damaged warehouse facilities and at least 12 vehicles. In a separate incident, a strike in the Bucha district injured three people and caused a fire at an industrial facility. These daytime attacks followed a massive barrage involving 35 missiles and 185 drones, during which a critical shortage of Patriot interceptors allowed ballistic missiles to inflict severe casualties and infrastructure damage in Kyiv and other regions.

data.title: US to Seek Resumed Kyiv-Moscow Talks, Rubio Says
data.description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio announced that Washington will intensify diplomatic efforts in the coming weeks to determine if peace negotiations between Ukraine and Russia can resume. Rubio noted that both sides maintain rigid “red lines” that must be brought closer together. The renewed diplomatic push coincides with expected visits to Kyiv by US peace envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner later in August, marking their first trip to the Ukrainian capital following multiple visits to Moscow.

data.title: Russian Drone Strikes High-Rise in Odesa, Injuring 3
data.description: A Russian attack drone has struck a multi-story residential building in the center of Odesa, injuring three people, according to local authorities. Both victims were hospitalized with thermal burns. The strike on Odesa follows a massive nationwide barrage on Saturday, during which Russia launched 35 missiles and 185 attack drones. During the overnight attack, Ukrainian air defenses intercepted only one of 27 ballistic missiles due to a critical shortage of Patriot interceptors, resulting in nine deaths and widespread destruction across Kyiv.

data.title: Ukraine Strikes Crimean Rail Bridges and Naval Drone Depot
data.description: Ukraine’s General Staff confirmed a series of strikes on Aug. 1 against Russian military targets in Crimea, the Kherson region, and the Zaporizhzhia region. In Crimea, Ukrainian forces hit a naval drone storage facility near Chornomorske, the Syvash railway bridge near Chonhar, a railway bridge near Vladyslavivka, a Black Sea Fleet electronic intelligence unit in Sevastopol, and a repair base in Pervomaiske. Additional strikes targeted a logistics depot in Podove, Kherson region, and a UAV depot in Tokmak, Zaporizhzhia region.

data.title: Russian Attack on Kyiv Damages Lithuanian Embassy, 25 Ambulances
data.description: A massive Russian missile and drone attack on Kyiv damaged the Lithuanian embassy and a medical transport depot, destroying five ambulances and significantly damaging 20 others on Saturday morning. Ukrainian officials confirmed the strike caused major disruptions to the city’s medical fleet. The broader attack killed nine residents and injured 30 others across seven districts, as air defenses struggled with a critical shortage of Patriot interceptors.

data.title: Drone Barrage Hits Ufa Refineries and Crimea Bases
data.description: On Saturday, Aug. 1, a massive Ukrainian drone strike targeted Russian oil refineries in Ufa, Bashkortostan, and military positions in occupied Crimea. The Russian Defense Ministry claimed to have intercepted 274 drones across 16 regions. In Ufa, flight operations were restricted as fires broke out at refinery facilities. In Crimea, satellite imagery confirmed fires at a Black Sea Fleet electronic warfare center on Cape Fiolent and an air defense base near the Kaya-Bash heights.

data.title: Ukraine Downs Only 1 Ballistic Missile During Massive Attack on Kyiv
data.description: A massive overnight Russian attack involving 35 missiles and 185 drones resulted in at least nine deaths and 30 injuries in Kyiv. Due to a critical shortage of Patriot interceptors, Ukrainian air defenses were only able to shoot down one ballistic missile. The strikes affected seven districts in the capital, damaging 18 residential buildings, educational facilities, and the Lithuanian embassy. Attacks also targeted the Dnipropetrovsk, Sumy, Kharkiv, and Poltava regions. President Volodymyr Zelensky urged international partners to expedite air defense deliveries to mitigate further casualties.

data.title: Russian E-Commerce Prices Surge After Wildberries Strikes
data.description: Prices for goods on major Russian online marketplaces, primarily Wildberries and Ozon, have surged by 10% to 30% in recent days following a series of Ukrainian drone strikes targeting logistics infrastructure. data.title: Polish F-16s Intercept Russian Il-20 Plane Over Baltic Sea
data.description: Two Polish F-16 fighter jets intercepted a Russian Il-20 reconnaissance aircraft flying over the Baltic Sea approximately 40 kilometers north of Kołobrzeg on July 31. Defense Minister Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz confirmed the aircraft remained in international airspace but was flying without a flight plan and with its transponder deactivated. The interception follows a July 30 incident in which a Russian Kh-101 cruise missile entered Polish airspace and crashed near Tarnawa-Kolonia in eastern Poland. Prime Minister Donald Tusk stated the missile was likely Russian, while NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte condemned the incursion.

‘Shifting export track from raw material sales to finished goods, a necessity’



TEHRAN- The Head of the Trade Promotion Organization of Iran (TPO), during a meeting with representatives and the board of directors of the Iran Guilds Chamber, announced the formulation of a new roadmap for a leap in non-oil exports and emphasized the strategic necessity of transitioning from raw and semi-raw material exports to high-value-added finished goods.

According to the Public Relations Department of the Trade Promotion Organization of Iran, this meeting was held with the aim of explaining new structures for guild participation in the international supply chain and examining operational solutions to remove administrative, currency, and regulatory obstacles facing guild exporters.

The Head of the Trade Promotion Organization of Iran, pointing to the structural challenge of the country's trade balance from a qualitative perspective, stated: One of the fundamental and problematic issues in foreign trade is the low average value of export goods compared to import items. Currently, the average value per ton of the country's export goods is about $300, while this figure for imported goods reaches about $2,000 per ton. This deep gap indicates the continuation of the traditional approach and reliance on raw material sales in the country's economy.

data.title: DSP o Maquiavélico Ganancioso
data.description: Guineenses, mais uma vez, venho para vos alertar sobre o perigo que Domingos Simões Pereira representa para a Guiné-Bissau. Faço esse alerta a todos os guineenses sem exceção que se encontre no país ou no estrangeiro, ao PAIGC em especial e na pessoa do Cipriano Cassamá em concreto. Alerta esse sobre o verdadeiro DSP, o verdadeiro espírito que move esse sujeito, o qual alguns ainda continuam a acreditar para não dizer adorar. Ele jamais coabitaria não só com JOMAV, assim como com qualquer presidente que seria eleito, a não ser o que ele apoiou disfarçadamente. Isto porque ele tem sua própria agenda, e o PAIGC é simplesmente uma plataforma para sua concretização. DSP jamais coabitaria com JOMAV porque o seu candidato preferido era o Paulo Gomes e sempre será, o qual juntamente com Tchitchi vão delineando mecanismo de modo a serem os novos donos da Guiné-Bissau. Depois dessa eleição legislativa, não importa o resultado, o Cipriano Cassama que se prepare a mala ou fica de bico fechado, pois o candidato preferido para o partido será o Paulo Gomes, e esse sim deve ter a voz dentro do partido. DSP é um ambicioso desmedido, nunca teve consideração por ninguém, JOMAV muito menos, o sujeito é um maquiavélico nato, Cipriano Casama será descartado quando menos esperar podes tomar a nota. Guineenses, falar do Paulo Gomes e Tchitchi é falar do MCCI e demais outras organizações e personalidades camufladas no nosso país. Esses dois indivíduos são os principais financiadores do MCCI e demais outras personalidades boca de aluguel na cidade de Bissau. Não tenho nada contra ninguém, mas quem continuar a perturbar verdadeira paz social dos guineenses em troca de benefícios como sempre foi nos últimos anos dessa crise, e que sempre tenho tolerado, então que fique claro "estou firme e determinado para tudo e todos". data.title: DSP, UM PERIGO GRAVE PARA FUTURO DO PAÍS
data.description: Os meios de comunicação também são as formas de manipulação mais utilizadas pelos poderes políticos, dado o seu impacto social. As informações são manipuladas não apenas tendo em vista omitir factos relevantes, mas também distorcer o conteúdo da informação veiculada, produzir ou forjar a opinião pública, de modo que a mesma se ajuste às ideias dos gananciosos. A única forma dos cidadãos evitarem cair nestes processos de manipulação é tornarem-se mais vigilantes em relação às instituições democráticas e aos órgãos de informação, adoptando uma atitude de permanente reflexão crítica sobre a informação que lhes é fornecida. Na Guiné-Bissau, nos últimos anos, cresceu exponencialmente o número de pessoas mediocres, pessoas sem escrúpulos ligadas à produção de rádios e outros meios de comunicação com influencia na nossa sociedade, gente que apesar da sua enorme influência na sociedade, trabalha na mais completa impunidade e sem qualquer controlo ético/democrático. Obcecado pelo poder, ciente da dificuldade do povo guineense em avaliar informações, ciente do poder dos instrumentos de comunicação, Domingos Simões Pereira (DSP) nunca menosprezou esses instrumentos para atingir seu objectivo, sempre usou-os de forma desonesta como agora está a fazer tudo por tudo para manter no controlo desses veicúlos, mesmo que isso custe a vida dos outros. Governou na corrupção, no nepotismo e no desvios de somas astronómicas do dinheiro de povo, que muito serviria para investimentos na saúde, educação e outros serviços publicos, para beneficiar familiares e amigos. Finge que preocupa com os problemas do país, mas só engana o povo honesto, humilde e trabalhador que infelizmente sofre muito, não sei até quando, devido a sua paciência e tolerância aos governantes como DSP, criminoso travestido em politico que vive na custa de povo e acima de tudo ainda fa-lo refem do próprio suor. Roubou e decepcionou tanto não só aos guineenses assim como a comunidade internacional que sempre acreditou que o sujeito era ideal para ajudar esse povo a sair do ciclo de sofrimento que parece infinito. Foi demitido, não conformou e está a fazer tudo na medida do possível para continuar a complicar a vida dos guineenses. Razão disso é que depois de perder a batalha nos meios de comunicações mais modernos nomeadamente os blogues onde investiu grandes somas do dinheiro de povo, para fazer a lavagem cerebral dos menos instruídos e não só. Fugiu do facebook onde sempre frequentava e comunicava com todos tentado passar a mensagem de um politico moderno e aberto a diálogo/opiniões, mas que afinal era simplesmente um falso modernista. Caiu a mascara e já não consegue enganar ninguem, pois a sua credibilidade está abaixo de zero, para não dizer outra coisa. Camaradas, para conhecimento geral, com o dinheiro roubado que custou suor de povo guineense, DSP decidiu avançar com um outro novo plano maquiavelico, para criar a sua própria estação de rádio. data.translatedTitle: DSP, A SERIOUS DANGER TO THE FUTURE OF THE COUNTRY
data.translatedDescription: The media is also the form of manipulation most used by political powers, given its social impact. Information is manipulated not only with a view to omitting relevant facts, but also distorting the content of the information conveyed, producing or forging public opinion, so that it fits the ideas of the greedy. The only way for citizens to avoid falling into these manipulation processes is to become more vigilant in relation to democratic institutions and information bodies, adopting an attitude of permanent critical reflection on the information provided to them. In Guinea-Bissau, in recent years, the number of mediocre people has grown exponentially, unscrupulous people linked to the production of radio stations and other means of communication with influence in our society, people who, despite their enormous influence in society, work with complete impunity and without any ethical/democratic control. Obsessed with power, aware of the difficulty of the Guinean people in evaluating information, aware of the power of communication instruments, Domingos Simões Pereira (DSP) never underestimated these instruments to achieve his objective, he always used them dishonestly and is now doing everything he can to maintain control of these vehicles, even if it costs the lives of others. He ruled through corruption, nepotism and the embezzlement of astronomical sums of people's money, which would largely be used for investments in health, education and other public services, to benefit family and friends. He pretends to care about the country's problems, but he only deceives the honest, humble and hard-working people who unfortunately suffer a lot, I don't know for how long, due to his patience and tolerance towards rulers like DSP, a criminal disguised as a politician who lives at the expense of the people and, above all, still holds them hostage to his own sweat. He stole and disappointed so much not only the Guineans but also the international community that always believed that the guy was ideal to help these people get out of the cycle of suffering that seems endless. He was fired, did not comply and is doing everything possible to continue complicating the lives of Guineans. The reason for this is that after losing the battle in the most modern means of communications, namely blogs, where he invested large sums of people's money, to brainwash the less educated and others. He fled Facebook where he always visited and communicated with everyone, trying to convey the message of a modern politician open to dialogue/opinions, but who, in the end, was simply a false modernist. The mask has fallen and it is no longer able to deceive anyone, as its credibility is below zero, to say the least. Comrades, for general knowledge, with the stolen money that cost the Guinean people sweat, DSP decided to move forward with another new Machiavellian plan, to create its own radio station. data.title: British Prime Minister: Scale of humanitarian disaster in Palestine unacceptable

In a press statement on Saturday, Burnham said that the government is considering taking measures regarding Israeli settlements in the West Bank, and these will be announced in due course.
